entries.question: Mpindura nte ubugari bw'umurongo w'ibumoso cyangwa nkawuhisha kuri tablet yanjye?

content.text: Ku idirishya rigari rya tablet kuri iOS cyangwa Android, kurura akabari gato kari hagati mu nkombe y'iburyo y'umurongo w'ibumoso kugira ngo uhindure ubugari bwawo. Kugabanya umurongo bihisha amazina y'aho ujya bigasigaramo amashusho yabyo gusa; wongere ubugari kugira ngo amazina agaruke. Kanda Hisha umurongo w'ibumoso iruhande rwa WitnessWork (hejuru y'umurongo w'ibumoso urimo amashusho gusa) kugira ngo uhishe kujya ahandi burundu. Kanda Erekana umurongo w'ibumoso mu mutwe w'urupapuro kugira ngo ugarure ubugari bwawe bwa nyuma bwabitswe. Ubugari bwawe n'uko bugaragara bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho nubwo wafunga porogaramu; ntibihuzwa kandi ntibishyirwa muri backup z'umurimo, kandi guhindura ubugari ntibihindura inyandiko zawe. Umurongo w'ibumoso ukenera idirishya rya nibura points 1.000 z'ubugari n'ingano y'inyandiko ishyigikiwe. Mu idirishya rito cyangwa inyandiko nini cyane, umurongo wo hasi uragaruka ubwawo; ongera ubugari bw'idirishya cyangwa uhindurire iramburiye kugira ngo wongere ukoreshe umurongo w'ibumoso. Abakoresha porogaramu zisoma ecran bashobora guhindura igikoresho Hindura ubugari bw'umurongo w'ibumoso kugira ngo bongere cyangwa bagabanye ubugari bwawo. Niba kujya ahandi bikibura, ongera utangize porogaramu hanyuma ukoreshe Uracyakeneye ubufasha? hepfo; ntushyire amakuru y'abantu n'andi makuru bwite muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.

entries.question: Nakoresha nte menu bar kuri iPad?

content.text: Kuri iPadOS 26 cyangwa irenzeho, koresha Windowed Apps cyangwa Stage Manager maze unyereze urutoki umanuka uvuye ku nkombe yo hejuru kugira ngo ugaragaze menu bar. Nyuma yo kuyitegura, Amahitamo ya WitnessWork afungura igenamiterere ryo muri porogaramu; ikintu gisanzwe Igenamiterere gifungura igenamiterere rya telefoni yawe. Dosiye ifungura Andika gusura…, Ongeraho igihe iyo kwandika amasaha bifunguye, Ongeraho umuntu, Gahunda nshya, na Kubika no Kugarura. Hindura → Shakisha umuntu bifungura urutonde rw'abantu kandi bigashyira ikarita ku gushakisha. Ubufasha bufungura Ikigo cy'ubufasha, Ibishya, porogaramu yawe ya imeri ku bufasha bwa bwite, cyangwa Genzura ibishya. Ibi byoroshyo bikoresha ecran zisanzwe; gufungura fomu nta byo bibika cyangwa ngo bisangize inyandiko zawe. Genzura ibishya igenzura niba hari ivugurura rya porogaramu rihuye kandi ikoresha uburyo busanzwe bwo gukuramo no gutangira bundi bushya iyo ririho. Ntishobora gushyiraho verisiyo nshya ya porogaramu, kandi ntiboneka mu miterere y'iterambere. Gushyigikirwa kwa menu bar bisaba porogaramu yashyizweho irimo ubwo bushobozi kandi ntiboneka kuri iPhone cyangwa Android. Niba ibintu bibura, vugurura ukoresheje iduka rya porogaramu maze ufungure WitnessWork bundi bushya. Ushobora gukoresha ibikorwa bimwe mu porogaramu. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha aho imeri ya bwite iri mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru bwite n'ibyabitswe mu bitekerezo rusange.

entries.question: Nigenza nte kugira ngo ngendere ku mfunguzo z'ibyoroshyo kuri iPad?

content.text: Huza clavier ya iPad ikoresha iPadOS 26 cyangwa irenzeho, hanyuma ufate ku kintu cya Command mu gihe imiyoborere nyamukuru igaragara. Utwandiko duto tw'ibyoroshyo tugaragara iruhande rw'utubuto two hasi cyangwa ibintu byo kuri sidebar. Kanda Command n'umubare ugaragara kugira ngo ufungure iyo ecran; irekure Command kugira ngo utwandiko dutwikirwe. Imibare ikurikiza uko imiyoborere igaragara, bityo mu buryo busanzwe Ahabanza ni Command 1 naho Abantu ni Command 2. Indi mibare iterwa n'ibintu bigaragara, harimo Igenamiterere kuri sidebar. Funga fomu cyangwa indi ecran yose ifunguye mbere yo gukoresha ibi byoroshyo; ntibibika cyangwa ngo bitere kureka inyandiko. Ikoreshwa ry'ibyoroshyo ni ryo ribarwa gusa, si ibyo wandika. Bisaba porogaramu yashyizweho ifite ubushobozi bwa clavier kandi ntibiboneka kuri iPhone cyangwa Android. Niba utwandiko tutagaragara, reba ko clavier ihujwe, garuka ku miyoborere nyamukuru, ushyire porogaramu ku gihe maze uyifungure bundi bushya. Burigihe ushobora gukanda ibintu by'imiyoborere. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha aho ubufasha bwa bwite buri mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru bwite mu bitekerezo rusange.

entries.question: Nakoresha nte trackpad, mouse cyangwa Apple Pencil kuri iPad?

content.text: Huza trackpad cyangwa mouse kuri iPad yawe, cyangwa wegereze Apple Pencil ishyigikiwe hejuru gato ya ecran. Utubuto, imirongo n'iminsi y'ikalendari bigaragara cyane mu gihe indanga ibinyuzeho. Iyo umurongo w'ibumoso wagabanyijwe ukaba ufite amashusho gusa, gushyira indanga ku shusho bigaragaza izina ryayo; utundi tubuto tudafite inyandiko, nko ku bikoresho by'ikarita no Amamenyesha, na two tugaragaza amazina yatwo. Shyira indanga ku rukuta rw'ibikorwa, ku gishushanyo cy'umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo, cyangwa ku nkingi y'ibirometero kugira ngo ubone itariki n'agaciro byayo. Ku ikarita, shyira indanga ku kimenyetso kugira ngo ubone izina ry'umuntu, cyangwa ku muntu uri ku rutonde rw'uruhande rw'ikarita kugira ngo ubone ikimenyetso cye. Gukanda kwa kabiri (gukanda n'intoki ebyiri) bifungura menu n'igaragaza rimwe nko gukanda ugakomeza. Umurongo wo guhindura ubugari bw'umurongo w'ibumoso ugaragaza imyambi yerekeza aho ushobora kwimukira, kandi gukurura n'intoki ebyiri bimura ifoto y'umuntu mu gihe uyikata. Byose biracyashoboka ukoresheje gukoraho: kanda, kanda ukomeze, cyangwa kurura nk'ibisanzwe. Gushyira indanga nta cyo bihindura ku nyandiko zawe. Hapimwa gusa ko indanga cyangwa Pencil byakoreshejwe, inshuro imwe ku munsi nibura; nta myanya, amazina cyangwa agaciro byoherezwa. Kuri Android, mouse igaragaza imirongo, amazina n'agaciro ku bishushanyo, ariko ibimenyetso ku ikarita ntibigaragaza amazina iyo indanga ibiriho. iPhone nta ndanga ifite. Niba nta kintu gisubiza, reba ko trackpad, mouse cyangwa Pencil bihujwe, ushyire porogaramu ku gihe maze uyifungure bundi bushya. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha aho ubufasha bwa bwite buri mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru bwite mu bitekerezo rusange.

entries.question: Ese igihe cyanjye cy'ukwezi gukurikira?

content.text: Yego. Igice cy'amasaha ari munsi y'intego yawe ya buri kwezi gishobora kwiyongera kugeza mu kwezi gutaha. Fungura Preferences → Publisher hanyuma uhindure amahitamo ya rollover. Amasaha yatwawe agaragara mu buryo bwikora iyo ukwezi gutangiye, bityo ntukeneye gukuramo intoki cyangwa kongera kwinjiza ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose.

entries.question: Ni mu buhe buryo inyigisho za Bibiliya zibarwa?

content.text: Ubushakashatsi bukorwa buri munsi, ntabwo bukorwa buri munsi. To count a study, open a contact, log a conversation, and mark it as "Conducted Bible Study." Kugira ngo wongere umubare w'abashakashatsi, andika ikiganiro cyo kwiga hamwe n'undi muntu ukora.

entries.question: Nshobora guhuza amakuru yanjye hagati y'ibikoresho?

content.text: iCloud Sync ni ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga kuri iOS. Fungura Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync kuri buri gikoresho gishyigikiwe, ukoresheje konti imwe ya iCloud, kugira ngo uhuze inyandiko z'umurimo, abantu, gusura n'amahitamo yawe. Amafoto afite akuma gatandukanye kitwa Shyiramo amafoto mu guhuza. Iyo nta interineti ihari, imimerere igira iti Gutegereza interineti; impinduka zawe zibikwa ku gikoresho kandi zigahuzwa uzasubira kuri interineti. Niba igikoresho cyinjiye muri Apple Account itandukanye, iCloud Sync iracika kuri cyo mbere y’uko inyandiko iyo ari yo yose isomwa cyangwa yoherezwa, kandi zikomeza kuba ku gikoresho; fungura guhuza nanone kugira ngo uhitemo uko kizahuzwa n’amakuru ya iCloud y’iyo konti. Icyo gikoresho kandi kireka gusangira imimerere y'Umuterankunga yo kuri konti yawe ya mbere; niba yaraguzwe ukoresheje konti ya App Store y'iki gikoresho, koresha Garura ibyigeze kugurwa. Igikoresho cyashyizweho hakoreshejwe backup y'ikindi gikoresho gihuza ubwacyo nk'igikoresho gishya. Guhuza kalendari ni ikiranga gitandukanye kandi cy'ubuntu gishyira Gusubirayo byawe bizaza muri kalendari yihariye; ntigihuza inyandiko za porogaramu hagati y'ibikoresho. Kuri Android, Abaterankunga bahuza telefoni na tablet bya Android bakoresheje Google Drive Sync (reba “Nahuza nte amakuru yanjye hagati y'ibikoresho bya Android?”). Guhuza hagati ya iPhone n'igikoresho cya Android ntibishoboka; koresha Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura kugira ngo wimure backup hagati yabyo.

entries.question: Nahuza nte amakuru yanjye hagati y'ibikoresho bya Android?

content.text: Google Drive Sync ni ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga kuri Android, kikiri mu igeragezwa (beta). Kuri buri telefoni cyangwa tablet ya Android, fungura Igenamiterere → Google Drive Sync ufungure Guhuza na Google Drive, hanyuma uhitemo Konti imwe ya Google mu idirishya rya Google, wemere ko WitnessWork ibika amakuru yayo muri Google Drive yawe. Ihuza inyandiko z'umurimo, gahunda, abantu, gusura, ibyiciro, ibirometero, umwirondoro n'amahitamo asangiwe; amafoto afite akuma gatandukanye kitwa Shyiramo amafoto mu guhuza. Buri gikoresho gifite akuma kacyo, kandi ibintu nk'uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru, uruhushya rw'isesengura n'intangiriro (onboarding) bikomeza kuba kuri buri gikoresho. Mu gihe WitnessWork ifunguye, impinduka ziturutse ku bindi bikoresho byawe zihagera mu gihe cy'umunota umwe cyangwa hafi, naho ubundi ubutaha uyifunguye; kanda Huza ubu kugira ngo urebe ako kanya. Ku gikoresho gishya cya Android, hitamo Kuri Google Drive ku rupapuro rwo gutangira rwitwa “Ngaho nimukomeze mujye aho mwasize” kugira ngo ugarure amakuru yawe, ibyo bikazana n'imimerere yawe y'Umuterankunga igihe iyo Konti ya Google ihujwe. Niba igikoresho gihuje Konti ya Google itandukanye, guhuza birazima kuri cyo mbere y'uko hagira icyo gisomwa cyangwa cyoherezwa, kandi inyandiko zawe zikomeza kuba ku gikoresho. Guhuza hagati ya iPhone n'igikoresho cya Android ntibishoboka; koresha Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura kugira ngo wimure backup hagati yabyo.

entries.question: Google Drive Sync ibika iki, kandi ni nde ushobora kukibona?

content.text: Buri gikoresho cya Android kibika kopi imwe y'amakuru yawe ya WitnessWork, hamwe n'amafoto (niba uyahisemo), mu bubiko buhishwe bwa porogaramu muri Google Drive ya konti wahujije. WitnessWork yonyine ni yo ishobora gufungura ubwo bubiko: ntibugaragara muri porogaramu ya Drive cyangwa kuri urubuga rwayo, izindi porogaramu ntizishobora kubusoma, kandi WitnessWork ntishobora kubona ikindi kintu cyose muri Drive yawe. Amakuru yawe anyura mu buryo butaziguye hagati y'igikoresho cyawe na Google kandi ntanyura kuri seriveri za WitnessWork. Google iyabika kuri Konti yawe ya Google nk'izindi dosiye zawe za Drive; ntahishwe impande zombi (end-to-end). WitnessWork ibika ku gikoresho gusa kode imwe y'iyo konti ihujwe, itari imeri yawe. Ubwo bubiko bubarwa mu bubiko bwawe bwa Google. Kugira ngo ubukureho, zimya guhuza kuri buri gikoresho, hanyuma muri Google Drive kuri murandasi ufungure Igenamiterere → Gucunga porogaramu → WitnessWork → Amahitamo → Siba amakuru ahishwe ya porogaramu. Gutandukanya Google Drive muri Igenamiterere → Google Drive Sync bihagarika uburyo bwo kugera kuri Drive buturutse kuri icyo gikoresho kandi bisiga ubwo bubiko ku bindi bikoresho byawe. Kugira ngo ukureho uburenganzira bwa WitnessWork ku bikoresho byose, yikureho muri Porogaramu na serivisi z'abandi muri Konti yawe ya Google. Backup zawe za JSON zo muri Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura zirihariye kandi zikomeza kuba aho wazibitse.

entries.question: Google Drive Sync ntikora ku gikoresho cyanjye cya Android. Ni iki nakwemeza?

content.text: Fungura Igenamiterere → Google Drive Sync usome imimerere. Reba ko buri gikoresho gihujwe na Konti imwe ya Google kandi ko serivisi za Google Play zashyizweho kandi zivuguruye. Niba imimerere ivuga ko ugomba kongera guhuza, kanda Ongera uhuze Google Drive wemere kugera nanone; Google irabaza nanone iyo uburenganzira bwakuweho mu igenamiterere rya Konti yawe ya Google. Niba ububiko bwawe bwa Google bwuzuye, impinduka zawe zikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho kugeza habonetse umwanya; vanaho ibintu cyangwa ugure ububiko bwisumbuyeho, hanyuma ukande Huza ubu. Guhuza bikenera interineti; imimerere igira iti Gutegereza interineti kugeza usubiye kuri interineti, kandi impinduka zakozwe nta interineti zoherezwa icyo gihe WitnessWork ifunguye. Niba ivuga ko Google Drive irahuze, Google iri kugabanya ibyifuzo mu gihe runaka; impinduka zawe zikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho kandi guhuza kongera kugerageza ubwako. Niba igikoresho gikoresha verisiyo nshya ya WitnessWork, vugurura ibikoresho byose. Google Drive Sync ikenera uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga; niba burangiye, guhuza birahagarara hanyuma bigakomeza uburenganzira bugarutse. Bika backup yoherejwe n'igikoresho gifite amakuru yawe aheruka mbere yo kongera kubaka amakuru ya Google Drive. Vugana n'ubufasha bwihariye uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha niba guhuza bikomeje kunanirwa, kandi ntushyire amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.

entries.question: Nashyira nte Gusubirayo muri kalendari yanjye?

content.text: Guhuza kalendari ni ubuntu kuri iPhone, iPad na Android. Iki gisubizo kivuga kuri iPhone na iPad, naho Guhuza kalendari bikora bite kuri Android? kivuga kuri Android. Mu gihe cyo gutangira bwa mbere, cyangwa ukoresheje ubutumire buri mu rwego rw'amamenyesha nyuma yo kuvugurura, kanda Ongeraho kuri kalendari kugira ngo ukore kalendari ya WitnessWork (muri iCloud iyo iboneka). Ushobora no kubikora igihe icyo ari cyo cyose muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari: emera kugera kuri kalendari yose, hanyuma ukore kalendari ya WitnessWork cyangwa uhitemo kalendari ikoreshwa kuri WitnessWork gusa. Kuvugurura bikenera kwinjira muri iCloud na interineti, no kuri kalendari za Google cyangwa Outlook. Kugira ngo ukoreshe Google cyangwa Outlook, kora kalendari kuri uwo mutanga serivisi, wongere konti muri Igenamiterere rya iPhone → Apps → Calendar → Calendar Accounts, ufungure kalendari zayo. Kalendari yawe isanzwe na kalendari zibitswe kuri iki gikoresho gusa ntizishobora guhitwamo. Kalendari imaze guhitwamo, buri Gusubirayo kuzaza kongerwaho ubwako, harimo ibyo wari warabitse, nk'igikorwa cy'iminota 30. Guhuza kalendari byongeraho Gusubirayo byose bizaza cyangwa nta na kimwe; kugira ngo uhagarike kubyongeraho, bizimye muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari. Gusubirayo byashize, Gahunda z'umurimo na Gahunda zisubiramo ntibyongerwaho. Buri gikorwa gihabwa imenyesha rimwe n'urwibutso rwa Menyesha njyewe rwa Gusubirayo kwacyo, kandi nta menyesha iyo Menyesha njyewe izimye. Utanga kalendari yawe ashobora kongeraho amamenyesha ye asanzwe; kuri Google, ubikureho muri Event notifications ya kalendari muri igenamiterere rya Google Calendar. Hindurira muri WitnessWork, kuko impinduka zakozwe muri kalendari, harimo amamenyesha, zishobora gusimbuzwa ku vugurura rikurikira.

entries.question: Guhuza kalendari bisangiza cyangwa bibika iki?

content.text: Mu buryo busanzwe, ibikorwa byoherejwe bigira umutwe rusange wa Gusubirayo, igihe n'igihe kizamara cy'gahunda, n'ihuza rifungura Gusura muri WitnessWork. Shyiramo amazina na aderesi ni uburyo bw'ubushake kandi bukoreshwa ku bikoresho byawe byose; kuwufungura byongeraho ayo makuru ku bikorwa byoherejwe. Inyandiko za Gusura n'ingingo za Gusubirayo ntizoherezwa na rimwe. Utanga kalendari wahisemo ashobora guhuza ibikorwa ku bindi bikoresho, kalendari zisangiwe na widget, bityo reba igenamiterere ryo gusangira ryo kuri iyo kalendari mbere yo gushyiramo amakuru arambuye. WitnessWork icunga gusa ibikorwa yashyizeho ikimenyetso ko ari ibyayo kandi ntinjiza gahunda zawe bwite zo muri kalendari. Inyandiko yihariye ya iCloud ibika amazina y'ibikoresho n'indangamuntu zihishe, nyiri ugutangaza, izina rya kalendari ihujwe n'ikimenyetso cya konti, amahitamo asangiwe, n'indangamuntu z'ibikorwa. Ibikubiye muri gahunda bikomeza kuba muri konti ya kalendari wahisemo. Indangamuntu ya kalendari ya buri gikoresho n'imimerere y'uguhuza bikomeza kuba ku gikoresho kandi bitandukanye no guhuza amakuru ya porogaramu cyangwa dosiye za backup.

entries.question: Kuki Guhuza kalendari bikoresha igikoresho nyamukuru?

content.text: Igikoresho kimwe gusa ni cyo cyohereza Gusubirayo byawe kugira ngo birinde ivugurura rirushanwa. Igikoresho cya mbere gihuza kiba nyamukuru. Ku bikoresho bya iOS bikoresha konti imwe ya iCloud, fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari kugira ngo wandike buri gikoresho, urebe urutonde rw'Igikoresho nyamukuru, kandi uhitemo igikoresho nyamukuru. Guhuza kalendari ubwabyo ntibikenera kuba Umuterankunga. Gusubirayo byahinduwe ku kindi gikoresho bigera ku gikoresho nyamukuru bicishijwe mu guhuza amakuru ya porogaramu gusanzwe, bikenera Umuterankunga na iCloud Sync ifunguye; fungura WitnessWork ku gikoresho nyamukuru kugira ngo bibyoherezwe. Nyuma yo kwimura, igikoresho gishya nyamukuru gikeneye kugera kuri konti imwe ya kalendari n'uruhushya rwuzuye rwa kalendari. Niba kwimura bitegereje, ongera ufungure WitnessWork ku gikoresho nyamukuru cya mbere kugira ngo kirangize igikorwa cyahagaze. Nta gufata inshingano ku buryo bwikora hashize igihe niba icyo gikoresho kitazongera kuboneka; koresha ubufasha bwihariye buri munsi ya Uracyakeneye ubufasha? mu Kigo cy'ubufasha. Gukuraho igikoresho cyashaje ku rutonde ntibisiba inyandiko zacyo cyangwa ibikorwa bya kalendari.

entries.question: Ibikorwa bya kalendari birabura cyangwa kuvugurura byarahagaze. Nakora iki?

content.text: Niba Guhuza kalendari kureka kuvugurura, amenyesha Ivugurura rya kalendari ryahagaritswe kigaragara mu rwego rw'amamenyesha (inzogera iri ku Ahabanza): ako kanya iyo hari ikigusabwa, nko kugera kuri kalendari, cyangwa nyuma y'umunsi ku bibazo bikunze gukemuka ubwabyo, nko kubura interineti. Kanda ugire icyo ukemura, cyangwa uhitemo Zimya niba utagishaka Gusubirayo muri kalendari yawe. Ushobora kandi gufungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari ugasoma ikosa ryerekanwa. Reba interineti yawe, kwinjira muri iCloud, konti ya kalendari, n'uruhushya rwuzuye rwa kalendari rwa WitnessWork mu Igenamiterere rya iPhone. Koresha Huza ubu ku gikoresho nyamukuru nyuma y'uko konti ya kalendari n'amakuru ya porogaramu birangiza guhuza. Kalendari yabuze igomba kongera guhuzwa cyangwa gusimbuzwa; kalendari zahinduriwe izina hanze ya WitnessWork zishobora gukenera guhitwamo nanone. Iyo igikorwa kizaza cyari cyoherejwe kibuze, kuvugurura birahagarara n'iyo iki gikoresho ari cyo cyakohereje: gutinda kw'guhuza kalendari, gusiba no kwimura igikorwa bishobora kugaragara kimwe. Tegereza ko konti ya kalendari irangiza guhuza kandi wemeze ko wahisemo kalendari imwe yihariye. Subiza inyuma ibikorwa bya WitnessWork wimuriye ahandi mbere yo kongera kugerageza. Garura ibikorwa byabuze ni uburyo bugaragara bwo gukosora nyuma y’ayo igenzura; ishobora gukora kopi zisubiramo niba kopi zikiri gukururwa cyangwa zikiri ahandi. Gusubirayo cyashize ntikongerwaho mu ntangiriro. Ku kwimura igikoresho bitegereje, ongera ufungure igikoresho nyamukuru cya mbere. Niba ikibazo gikomeje, koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwihariye bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha ushyiremo verisiyo ya porogaramu, igikoresho na verisiyo ya sisitemu y'imikorere, n'ikosa ryerekanwe. Ntushyire amakuru y'abantu, amafoto ya kalendari, inyandiko na backup muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.

entries.question: Bigenda bite iyo nzimije Guhuza kalendari cyangwa nkavanaho WitnessWork?

content.text: Muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari, hitamo Zimya guhuza kalendari, cyangwa uhitemo Zimya ku kimenyetso Ivugurura rya kalendari ryahagaritswe. Ku gikoresho nyamukuru, kivugurura kalendari yawe, ushobora kubika ibikorwa bimaze kongerwaho cyangwa ukabikuraho. Kuraho ibikorwa bikuraho ibikorwa bifite ikimenyetso muri kalendari wahisemo, harimo amateka yoherejwe mbere; ibikorwa bitari ibya WitnessWork na kalendari ubwayo bisigara. Kuzimya ku gikoresho nyamukuru bihagarika kuvugurura kuri buri gikoresho. Ku kindi gikoresho cyose, Guhuza kalendari kuzima kuri icyo gikoresho gusa kandi ibikorwa bigasigara. Ibikorwa wabitse, cyangwa bisigaye nyuma yo kuvanaho porogaramu, ntibigivugururwa kugeza wongeye gutegura Guhuza kalendari. Kuvanaho WitnessWork ntibikuraho ibikorwa bya kalendari. entries.question: Guhuza kalendari bikora bite kuri Android?

content.text: Guhuza kalendari ni ubuntu kuri Android. Kalendari yakozwe ku gikoresho ikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho; kalendari ya Google igaragara no ku bindi bikoresho byawe no kuri murandasi. Kalendari nkuru ntishobora guhitwamo. Buri Gusubirayo kuzaza noneho kongerwaho nk'igikorwa cy'iminota 30 gifite imenyesha rimwe n'urwibutso rwa Menyesha njyewe; Guhuza kalendari byongeraho Gusubirayo byose bizaza cyangwa nta na kimwe. Gusubirayo byashize na Gahunda ntibyongerwaho. Kuvugurura bikorwa iyo ufunguye WitnessWork no nyuma y'uko ubitse impinduka, kandi Huza ubu bivugurura ako kanya. Ibisobanuro bya buri gikorwa bifite ihuza rya WitnessWork rigaragaza Gusubirayo kwacyo, bityo ivugurura rihindura igikorwa gisanzweho aho kongeraho ikindi, n'iyo ikindi gikoresho cya Android kivugurura kalendari imwe ya Google. Ntuhindure iryo huza. Igikorwa usibye muri porogaramu ya kalendari kigaruka ku vugurura rikurikira. Android nta gikoresho nyamukuru igira kandi ntikoresha iCloud, kandi Shyiramo amazina na aderesi bikoreshwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa. Niba kuvugurura bihagaze, urugero kuko uburenganzira bwo kugera kuri kalendari bwazimijwe, amenyesha Ivugurura rya kalendari ryahagaritswe kigaragara mu rwego rw'amamenyesha; kanda ugire icyo ukemura, cyangwa ufungure Guhuza kalendari usome ikosa, hanyuma ukoreshe Fungura Igenamiterere cyangwa Huza ubu. Zimya guhuza kalendari ubika cyangwa ukuraho ibikorwa bya WitnessWork; ntibisiba kalendari cyangwa ibindi bikorwa byawe. Kuvanaho WitnessWork bisiga ibikorwa byayo, bityo ubikureho mbere niba utabishaka. entries.question: Hari porogaramu ya Apple Watch?

content.text: Yego, kuri iPhone ifite Apple Watch ikoresha watchOS 26 cyangwa irenzeho. Ishyirwaho ubwayo niba Automatic App Install ifunguye; naho ubundi fungura porogaramu ya Watch kuri iPhone yawe, shaka WitnessWork muri Available Apps, hanyuma ukande Install. Hanyuma fungura WitnessWork kuri iPhone yawe rimwe kugira ngo isaha yawe ibone iterambere ryawe. Ku isaha ushobora kongeraho igihe cy'uyu munsi hamwe n'Ubwoko (si ngombwa), gutangiza no guhagarika by'agateganyo igihe kibarwa cya iPhone yawe, no kubika igihe cyacyo nk'inyandiko. Niba utandika amasaha nk'Umubwiriza w'Ubwami, ushobora kwerekana ko wasangije abandi ubutumwa bwiza muri uku kwezi. Complication ebyiri zishobora gushyirwa ku isura y'isaha cyangwa muri Smart Stack: Iterambere ry'ukwezi rigaragaza amasaha yawe ugereranyije n'intego y'uku kwezi, rifite akamenyetso ku hantu gahunda zawe zikugeza uyu munsi; mu mwanya uzengurutse ushobora guhitamo uruziga cyangwa igipimo, intego yawe iri ku mpera yarwo cyangwa isaha iri munsi, kandi nta ntego, rigaragaza amasaha yawe gusa. Ibikurikira bigaragaza gusubirayo kwawe gukurikira cyangwa gahunda yawe ikurikira. Ushobora kandi gukoresha Siri ku isaha yawe kugira ngo wongereho igihe, utangize, uhagarike cyangwa uhagarike burundu igihe kibarwa, wandike urugendo, ukoresheje amagambo amwe nko kuri iPhone, nka "Ongeraho igihe muri WitnessWork" cyangwa "Andika urugendo muri WitnessWork". iPhone yawe ni yo ibika inyandiko zawe. Isaha yakira iterambere ryawe ry'ukwezi, imimerere ya raporo, igihe kibarwa, Ubwoko, amazina y'imodoka n'igipimo cy'intera, naho kuri Ibikurikira yakira izina, aderesi n'ingingo bya gusubirayo kwawe, n'umutwe n'ahantu bya gahunda zawe z'ibyumweru bibiri biri imbere. Ntiyakira inyandiko cyangwa andi makuru y'abantu, kandi ntishobora guhindura cyangwa gusiba inyandiko. Porogaramu y'isaha ikenera iPhone yawe, bityo ntiboneka kuri Apple Watch yashyizweho hakoreshejwe Family Setup. Ukoresha telefoni ya Android, koresha porogaramu ya Wear OS aho.

Niba isaha ivuga ko igihe kibarwa cyahindutse kuri iPhone yawe, reba igihe hanyuma ugerageze nanone. Niba isaha yawe ikomeza kutavugururwa, komeza iPhone yawe hafi kandi idafunze, fungura WitnessWork kuri iPhone yawe, hanyuma uyifungure ku isaha yawe. entries.question: Ibikurikira kuri Apple Watch yanjye bigaragaza iki?

content.text: Ibikurikira bigaragaza icyo kibanjirije ikindi: gusubirayo kwawe gukurikira cyangwa gahunda yawe ikurikira. Gahunda zigaragara gusa niba wandika amasaha. Ongeraho complication ya Ibikurikira ku isura y'isaha cyangwa muri Smart Stack: kanda ufate ku isura y'isaha ukande Edit, cyangwa ukoreshe porogaramu ya Watch kuri iPhone yawe. Kiba kandi ku rupapuro rw'ibanze rwa porogaramu y'isaha. Gusubirayo cyangwa gahunda bikomeza kugaragara iminota 15 nyuma yo gutangira, kugira ngo urebe aderesi cyangwa ingingo ugeze aho, hanyuma ikurikira ikabisimbura. Gahunda idafite igihe cyo gutangira yerekanwa umunsi wose, nyuma y'ibifite igihe by'uwo munsi. Gusubirayo byatinze ntibigaragara; ubibone muri WitnessWork kuri iPhone yawe. Amazina n'ingingo bihishwa iyo ukuboko kwawe kuri hasi cyangwa isaha yawe ifunze, kuko abandi bashobora kubona isura y'isaha yawe. Kanda Ibikurikira kugira ngo ubifungure, hanyuma ukande Inzira kugira ngo ubone inzira muri Maps ku isaha yawe, cyangwa Tangiza igihe kibarwa kugira ngo utangize igihe kibarwa cy'umurimo cya iPhone yawe kuri gahunda; igihe kibarwa gikenera iPhone yawe iri hafi. Ibikurikira bireba ibyumweru bibiri biri imbere kandi bikomeza kugenda iPhone yawe itari hafi. Impinduka ukora kuri iPhone yawe zigera ku isaha yawe ubutaha zihuye. Niba itaravugururwa, fungura WitnessWork kuri iPhone yawe, hanyuma ku isaha yawe. entries.question: WitnessWork Buddies ni iki, kandi kuki ntayibona?

content.text: Buddies igufasha guhuza n'abantu bagera kuri batanu mujyana kubwiriza no kubonana gahunda zanyu z'iminsi, ibihe byo gutangira, n'igihe bimara mu byumweru umunani biri imbere. Unabona ibimenyetso buri mugenzi asangiza. Ikora kuri iPhone, iPad na Android, kandi bagenzi bari ku mbuga zitandukanye bashobora guhuza. Kanda umunsi ubone abo ari bo. Fungura Ingengabihe, ukande Buddies hejuru, urangize intangiriro ukoresheje izina ry'umwirondoro wawe. Akadomo kuri iyo buto kavuga ko hari icyifuzo gitegereje ko wemeza. Buddies ishobora kutaboneka mu gihe cyo gutangizwa buhoro buhoro. Vugurura porogaramu washyizeho niba buto ya Buddies ibura. Niba buto yijimye, Buddies ntiboneka by'agateganyo; bagenzi wabitse bagumaho ku ngengabihe yawe, bityo ongera ugerageze nyuma.

entries.question: Nongeraho nte mugenzi, kandi ni nde wemeza icyifuzo?

Ushobora no gushyiramo ihuza ukoresheje Andika ihuza ry'ubutumire. Uwakiriye akanda Emera; uwakoze ubutumire akoherezwa gufungura Buddies → Ibisabwa agakanda Emeza. Utangira kubona gahunda za buri wese nyuma y'uko kwemeza gusa. Emeza gusa umuntu wari ugamije gutumira.

entries.question: Kuki Ubutumire bwanjye bwa Buddies butegereje, bwararangiye, cyangwa buvuga ko imyanya yose ikoreshwa?

content.text: Icyifuzo cyakiriwe gitegereza kugeza uwatumiye acyemeje muri Buddies → Ibisabwa. Buri Butumire bwa Buddies bukora rimwe kandi burarangira nyuma y'iminsi irindwi; saba ihuza rishya niba ryarakoreshejwe, ryarahagaritswe cyangwa ryararangiye. Imyanya yawe itanu ibarwamo bagenzi n'ubutumire cyangwa ibyifuzo bitegereje. Hagarika ubutumire budakoreshwa cyangwa ukureho mugenzi kugira ngo habeho umwanya. Umubare muto gusa w'amahuza y'ubutumire adakoreshwa ushobora kuba ufunguye icyarimwe. Niba gukanda ihuza ry'ubutumire bifungura urubuga aho gufungura WitnessWork, shyiraho WitnessWork iva muri App Store cyangwa Google Play ukande ihuza nanone, cyangwa ukoporore ihuza ukarishyira muri Buddies → Andika ihuza ry'ubutumire. Niba gusikana bidashoboka, emerera kamera mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe cyangwa usangize kandi ushyiremo ihuza ry'ubutumire.

content.text: Gusangira kalendari mu buryo bwikora bikubiyemo izina ryawe n'iminsi wateganyije, ibihe byo gutangira n'igihe bimara mu byumweru umunani biri imbere. Ifoto, ubupayiniya, n'urukurikirane rwawe ni ibyo guhitamo; bihindure muri Igenamiterere rya Buddies. Gusangira kalendari ntibikubiyemo igihe cy'umurimo wawe cyanditswe, raporo, intego, ibyiciro, urutonde rw'abantu, amateka yo gusura cyangwa inyandiko. entries.question: Ntumira nte mugenzi muri Gahunda cyangwa Gusubirayo, nkasubiza ubutumire?

content.text: Koresha Tumira bagenzi iyo wongeraho cyangwa uhindura Gahunda cyangwa Gusubirayo giteganyijwe, hitamo bagenzi bemejwe, hanyuma ubike. Ku rupapuro rwa Gahunda, cyangwa ku rupapuro rw'ikiganiro cya Gusubirayo giteganyijwe, Tumira bagenzi itumira umuntu ako kanya. Ushobora kandi gukanda Tumira muri Gahunda ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi. Ubutumire bwa Gahunda busangiza itariki, igihe, uburebure, umutwe, ahantu n'icyitonderwa byayo. Ubutumire bwa Gusubirayo busangiza itariki n'igihe byayo, izina rya mbere rya nyir'inzu, aderesi cyangwa akamenyetso, n'ingingo; ayo makuru arangira umunsi umwe nyuma yo gusura. Reba ko ushaka gusangiza ayo makuru n'abantu wahisemo. Ubutumire bwa Gusubirayo ntibuboneka mu Buryo bwo kurinda amakuru. Kugira ngo usubize, hitamo Ndagenda cyangwa Sinshobora mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza, ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi muri Buddies, cyangwa ku rupapuro rw'ubutumire ubwarwo (rukande mu nzogera, ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi, cyangwa ku munsi muri Ingengabihe kugira ngo urufungure); ushobora guhindura igisubizo cyawe nyuma. Urupapuro rw'ubutumire bwa Gusubirayo rugaragaza igihe mugenzi wawe azagenda, izina rya mbere rya nyir'inzu, ingingo n'ahantu, hamwe n'inzira. Ubutumire buguma mu nzogera kugeza usubije cyangwa buhagaritswe cyangwa bukarangira, bityo ntibushobora gukurwaho kubw'impanuka; nyuma yo gusubiza, ushobora kubukuraho. Kujya muri Gahunda byongera Gahunda ihujwe ku ngengabihe yawe, ikurikiza impinduka cyangwa guhagarikwa n'uwatumiye. Sinshobora ikura Gahunda ku ngengabihe yawe, kandi guhindukira ukagaruka kuri Ndagenda ku rupapuro rwa Gahunda iragarura. Ubutumire bwa Gusubirayo ntibwinjiza umuntu cyangwa amateka yo gusura.

entries.question: Nsaba nte kwifatanya muri Gahunda ya mugenzi wanjye?

content.text: Kanda umunsi ku ngengabihe yawe ya Ingengabihe, hanyuma ukande Saba kwifatanya iruhande rwa mugenzi uteganya kujya kubwiriza uwo munsi. Ushobora kandi gukanda umwe mu minsi ye munsi ya Ibyumweru bibiri bikurikira ku rupapuro rw'amakuru ye. Icyifuzo cyawe gisangiza gusa ibyo usanzwe ubona: umunsi, igihe n'uburebure bwa Gahunda ye. Kigaragara nka Wasabye kugeza mugenzi wawe agutumiye, ukisubiza, cyangwa Gahunda itangiye; kanda Wasabye kugira ngo ucyisubize. Gusaba bifunga amasaha abiri mbere y'uko Gahunda itangira, kandi ushobora kugira ibyifuzo bigera ku bitatu bitegereje kuri buri mugenzi. Mugenzi wawe amenyeshwa gusa ubwa mbere usabye Gahunda, kandi ku byifuzo bitarenga bitatu ku munsi. Niba yimuye cyangwa akuyeho iyo Gahunda, icyifuzo cyawe kirisubizwa kuri wowe. Wasabye kigaragara gusa ku gikoresho wasabyeho. Mugenzi wawe nagutumira, subiza mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza. Niba uhisemo Ndagenda ufite Gahunda yawe bwite icyo gihe, y'inshuro imwe cyangwa yisubiramo, ushobora kuyisimbuza kuri uwo munsi kugira ngo igihe cyawe kitabarwa kabiri. Gahunda yisubiramo ikomeza ku yindi minsi yawe.

entries.question: Nsubiza nte cyangwa nzimya nte ibyifuzo byo kwifatanya muri Gahunda zanjye?

content.text: Iyo mugenzi asabye kwifatanya muri imwe muri Gahunda zawe, icyifuzo cye kigaragara mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza. Kanda Tumira kugira ngo umwongere kuri Gahunda yawe kandi wohereze ubutumire ako kanya; buto ihinduka akamenyetso k'ukuri. Kanda icyifuzo ubwacyo kugira ngo ufungure Gahunda, aho Tumira ikora kimwe. Kanda Si ubu (cyangwa ukireke) kugira ngo ugikureho bucece: mugenzi wawe ntabimenyeshwa na rimwe, kandi icyifuzo kirangira Gahunda itangiye. Niba Gahunda yaturutse ku butumire bw'undi, uwayiteguye gusa ni we ushobora gutumira. Gutumira umuntu ku itariki imwe ya gahunda yisubiramo bituma iyo tariki iba Gahunda yayo y'inshuro imwe, kandi gahunda yisubiramo ikomeza uko iri ku yindi minsi yawe. Niba Gahunda zawe z'uwo munsi zahindutse kuva yasaba, fungura Gahunda ugumana kugira ngo umutumire. Kugira ngo uhagarike amamenyesha y'ibyifuzo byose, zimya Imenyesha ryo Saba kwifatanya muri Igenamiterere rya Buddies. Kugira ngo uhagarike amamenyesha ya mugenzi umwe, zimya Imenyesha ryo Saba kwifatanya ku rupapuro rw'amakuru ye, cyangwa ukande igihe kirekire icyifuzo cye uhitemo Zimya amamenyesha. Ibyifuzo biracyagaragara mu nzogera uko byaba bimeze kose. Si ubu n'ayo magenamiterere bikora kuri iki gikoresho gusa, bityo icyifuzo wakuyeho ku gikoresho kimwe gishobora kugaragara ku kindi.

entries.question: Amamenyesha ya Buddies avuga iki, kandi ni nde ushobora kuyabona?

content.text: Amamenyesha ya Buddies avuga uwakoze iki, akoresheje izina ry'irihimbano wahaye mugenzi niba warariteguye: urugero, “Anna yagutumiye muri Gahunda” hamwe n'umunsi n'igihe byayo, “Joe ntashobora”, “Levi yifuza kwifatanya nawe” cyangwa “Levi yabonye ikimenyetso” hamwe n'izina ry'ikimenyetso. Amenyesha ya Gusubirayo yerekana gusa umunsi n'igihe byayo, ntiyerekana izina rya nyir'inzu, aderesi cyangwa ingingo, naho amenyesha ya Gahunda ntiyerekana umutwe wayo, ahantu cyangwa icyitonderwa. Seriveri ya WitnessWork ntibona na rimwe aya mazina cyangwa amakuru: buri menyesha rigera ubutumwa bwa mugenzi wawe bugihishe, kandi igikoresho cyawe kirabufungura kikandika amenyesha ubwacyo. Ako kanya nyuma yo gutangiza igikoresho bundi bushya, mbere y'uko ugifungura bwa mbere, cyangwa iyo ubutumwa budasomeka, ubona amenyesha rusange nka “Ubutumire bushya” aho kubona izina; fungura inzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza kugira ngo urebe uwabukoze. Niba amamenyesha atigeze yerekana izina ry'umuntu, vugurura WitnessWork. Amamenyesha ashobora kugaragara kuri ecran ifunze; kugira ngo uhishe ibyo avuga kugeza ufunguye, hindura igenamiterere rya ecran ifunze mu igenamiterere ry'amamenyesha ry'igikoresho cyawe. Kugira ngo uhitemo amamenyesha ya Buddies iki gikoresho kibona, koresha Amamenyesha ya Buddies, Imenyesha ryo Saba kwifatanya, na Imenyesha ry'ibimenyetso muri Igenamiterere rya Buddies, cyangwa uzimye Imenyesha ryo Saba kwifatanya kuri mugenzi umwe ku rupapuro rw'amakuru ye. Byose biracyagaragara mu nzogera y'amamenyesha. Kuri Android, amamenyesha ya Buddies akenera serivisi za Google Play. Niba areka kugera, reba ko amamenyesha yemerewe WitnessWork mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe, hanyuma ufungure Buddies kugira ngo ivugurure. Niba akomeje kutagera, menyesha ikibazo uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha utashyizemo amazina cyangwa andi makuru bwite.

entries.question: Ni iki kiri ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi, kandi nshobora kumuhindurira izina cyangwa ibara?

content.text: Fungura Buddies ukande mugenzi. Bikeneye igisubizo cyawe ni urutonde rw'ubutumire bwe utarasubiza; hitamo Ndagenda cyangwa Sinshobora aho cyangwa mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza. Hamwe ni urutonde rwa Gahunda na Gusubirayo bizaza hagati yanyu, uwatumiye uwo ari we wese, hamwe na buri gisubizo; kanda Gahunda kugira ngo ufungure urupapuro rwayo, cyangwa ukoreshe menu iri ku butumire bwa mugenzi kugira ngo uhindure igisubizo cyawe. Ibyumweru bibiri bikurikira bigaragaza iminsi mugenzi wawe ateganya kujya kubwiriza iruhande rw'iyawe; kanda umwe mu minsi ye kugira ngo uteganye igihe kimwe cyangwa usabe kwifatanya. Tumira muri Gahunda ifungura Gahunda nshya na mugenzi uwo asanzwe yatumiwe, naho Reba kuri kalendari ifungura Ingengabihe. Izina ry'irihimbano ni izina ry'ibanga ubona wenyine; mugenzi wawe ntabimenyeshwa, kandi kurikuraho bigarura izina rye bwite. Abaterankunga bashobora guhitamo ibara rya mugenzi muri ibara rimwe n'ibara nyamukuru, cyangwa ibara iryo ari ryo ryose bakoresheje eyedropper; Ibisanzwe bigarura ibara ryatanzwe igihe mwahujwe, ibyo abandi bose bakomeza kugira. Amazina y'irihimbano n'amabara bibikwa hamwe n'amakuru yawe ahishwe ya Buddies, bityo bigaruka iyo Buddies igarurwa ku kindi gikoresho. Gahunda ye yose y'ibyumweru umunani biri imbere iri kuri kalendari yawe mu gihe Erekana kuri kalendari yanjye ifunguye.

entries.question: Kuki gahunda cyangwa ubutumire bwa mugenzi bibura cyangwa ntibigezweho?

content.text: Reba ko icyifuzo cyemejwe kandi Erekana kuri kalendari yanjye ifunguye kuri uwo mugenzi. Gusangira kalendari bikubiyemo ibyumweru umunani biri imbere gusa. Abantu bombi bakeneye interineti kugira ngo bohereze kandi bakire impinduka; fungura Buddies umanure kugira ngo uvugurure. Gahunda zakuruwe mbere zikomeza kugaragara nta interineti, ariko impinduka nshya zikeneye interineti; Buddies ivuga iyo udafite interineti cyangwa itashoboye kuvugurura. Kubona kalendari ya mugenzi ntibyongera gahunda ze ku zawe. Fungura Amamenyesha ya Buddies muri Igenamiterere rya Buddies no mu igenamiterere ry'amamenyesha ry'igikoresho cyawe, kandi urebe inzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza ku butumire n'iyo nta menyesha ryaje. Kuri Android, amamenyesha ya Buddies akenera serivisi za Google Play; nta zo, impinduka zigeraho iyo ufunguye WitnessWork. Inzogera igenzura ibikorwa bishya bya Buddies iyo uyifunguye n'iyo usubiye muri WitnessWork; niba ivuga ko itashoboye kugenzura, ongera uhuze kandi ukande Ongera ugerageze.

entries.question: Kuki igisubizo cyanjye kigira kiti Kohereza nyuma ya cyangwa Ntiharoherezwa, cyangwa icyifuzo cyanjye kigira kiti Gutegereza koherezwa?

content.text: Ndagenda yoherezwa kuri mugenzi wawe ako kanya. Sinshobora itegereza amasegonda 15 mbere, mu gihe wayikanze kubw'impanuka: kanda Hindura kugira ngo uyikosore mbere y'uko yoherezwa. Kuva muri porogaramu bihita byohereza. Ntiharoherezwa cyangwa Gutegereza koherezwa bivuze ko igisubizo cyawe cyangwa icyifuzo cyawe cyo Saba kwifatanya kitaragera kuri mugenzi wawe, akenshi kuko udafite interineti cyangwa Buddies itaboneka by'agateganyo. Ntukeneye gusubiza cyangwa gusaba nanone: kibitswe kuri iki gikoresho kandi cyoherezwa ubwacyo ubutaha Buddies ivugurura, nko iyo ufunguye Buddies cyangwa usubiye muri WitnessWork ufite interineti. Kugira ngo cyoherezwe vuba, ongera uhuze, ufungure Buddies, umanure kugira ngo uvugurure. Mugenzi wawe ntazabona igisubizo cyangwa icyifuzo kugeza cyoherejwe.

entries.question: Mpisha nte mugenzi, nkareka gusangira, cyangwa nkasiba amakuru yanjye ya Buddies?

content.text: Fungura amakuru ya mugenzi uzimye Erekana kuri kalendari yanjye kugira ngo uhishe gahunda ze kuri iki gikoresho; gusangira birakomeza, kandi Gahunda zawe bwite hamwe na we ziracyagaragara. Kuraho mugenzi irangiza isano ku bantu bombi, kandi kongera guhuza bisaba ubutumire bushya. Ntibamenyeshwa, ariko bashobora kubibona. Niba gukuraho bitegereje udafite interineti, bashobora kubona gahunda zawe zasangijwe za nyuma kugeza WitnessWork yongeye guhuzwa ikarangiza. Igenamiterere rya Buddies → Siba amakuru yanjye ya Buddies ikuraho amasano yose n'ubutumire kandi isiba amakuru yawe ahishwe ya Buddies n'indangamuntu y'ihishwa. Ntishobora gusubirwamo; ongera uhuze kandi wongere ugerageze niba gusiba bitegereje. Inyandiko zawe bwite z'umurimo n'abantu birakomeza.

entries.question: Ibimenyetso bikora bite, kandi nabibona he?

content.text: Ibimenyetso byishimira imigenzo myiza mu murimo wawe, nko kugira uruhare mu murimo buri kwezi, kohereza raporo yawe, no gusubira gusura abantu. Nta cyo ugomba gutegura: WitnessWork igenzura inyandiko zawe kandi ikongeraho ikimenyetso iyo ugezeho. Kugira ngo ubone ibyawe, kanda ifoto yawe, hanyuma Umwirondoro. Ibimenyetso byawe biri munsi y'ikarita y'umwirondoro wawe; kanda kimwe kugira ngo ukirebe neza, cyangwa ukande Reba byose kugira ngo ufungure Ibimenyetso, aho ubona buri kimenyetso ufite n'icyo cyafasha buri kimwe gukura. Ibimenyetso byinshi bikura mu nzego enye: Umuringa, Ifeza, Zahabu, n'Imaragarita. Ibimenyetso bike by'inshuro imwe, nka Icyigisho cya mbere cya Bibiliya, bigumaho bihishe kugeza ubibonye. Iyo ikintu wakoze vuba aha gihesha ikimenyetso, nko kwandika igihe, kwemeza ko wagize uruhare mu murimo, kubika gusura cyangwa gahunda, kohereza raporo yawe, gusubiza Ndagenda, cyangwa kwemeza mugenzi, cyishimirwa ako kanya. Ikimenyetso kije muundi buryo, nko kugera kw'umunsi wa gahunda nijoro, igihe cyanditswe kuri watch yawe cyangwa ku kindi gikoresho, cyangwa igisubizo cya mugenzi, nticyakubangamira: ikarita y'Ikimenyetso gishya hejuru ya Ahabanza igitangaza. Kanda Reba kugira ngo ukirebe neza, cyangwa X kugira ngo ukureho ikarita; uko byagenda kose ikimenyetso kirabikwa kandi kigumaho kiranzwe gishya ku mwirondoro wawe kugeza ufunguye ibimenyetso byawe. Niba inyandiko imwe ihesha ikimenyetso kandi ikageza urukurikirane ku ntambwe, urukurikirane rurishimirwa naho ikimenyetso kigategereza kuri Ahabanza. Niba inyandiko zawe zimaze kugera ku bimenyetso ubwa mbere WitnessWork izigenzuye ku gikoresho, ecran y'inshuro imwe “Ibimenyetso byawe biri hano” ikubwira umubare ufite: Reba ifungura umwirondoro wawe, naho Nyuma ikayifunga. Itegereza igihe ufunguye WitnessWork nta rugendo rw'ivugurura. Ibimenyetso bigezweho n'inyandiko wongeraho cyangwa ugarura mu gihe ushyiraho WitnessWork byongerwa hatabayeho iyo ecran. Uko byagenda kose, ibimenyetso byawe byamaze kubikwa. Ibimenyetso bikora kuri iOS na Android kandi bivugururwa mu kanya gato nyuma y'uko inyandiko zawe zihindutse n'igihe cyose usubiye muri WitnessWork. Si nomero itukura uri ku kimenyetso cya porogaramu, ubara ibitarasomwa mu nzogera y'amamenyesha.

entries.question: Nabona nte ikimenyetso neza cyangwa nkagisangiza?

content.text: Kanda ikimenyetso icyo ari cyo cyose, ku mwirondoro wawe, kuri ecran y'Ibimenyetso, cyangwa ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi muri Buddies, maze gifunguke ku ecran yose: ikimenyetso, urwego rwacyo, icyo kibara, n'igihe wagiriye. “Byabonetse mu mateka yawe” bisobanura ko inyandiko za kera zagezeho kandi ukwezi kutazwi. Munsi y'ibimenyetso byawe, umurongo nka “Ikurikira: Imaragarita · amezi 41 kuri 60” werekana uko ikimenyetso kiri kure y'urwego rukurikira, cyangwa “Inzego zose uko ari enye zabonetse” iyo ufite Imaragarita; kanda akabuto k'amakuru kari iruhande rwacyo kugira ngo ubone icyafasha gukura. Urwego utaragera rwerekana “Ntiragerwaho” n'uko wagerayo. Kanda ikimenyetso kugira ngo gikuruke. Kugira ngo ugisangize, fata ifoto ya ecran: ecran yerekana izina ryawe, nka “Ikimenyetso cya Anna,” na WitnessWork hasi, kandi nta kintu cyoherezwa ubwacyo. Izina ryawe rituruka ku mwirondoro wawe, muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Umwirondoro; nta zina, ecran irisiga. Funga ikimenyetso ukoresheje X, unyeganyeza umanuka, cyangwa Garuka kuri Android. Muri Buddies, ibisubizo bya bagenzi bawe bigaragara munsi y'ikimenyetso cyawe, kandi ikimenyetso cya mugenzi kikwemerera kumwoherereza kimwe; reba ikibazo kijyanye n'ibyo bagenzi babona.

entries.question: Kuki ibimenyetso bibara amezi aho kubara amasaha?

content.text: Kugira ngo buri wese akure ku muvuduko umwe, uko ibimeze kose. Buri kimenyetso kibara amezi y'ikalendari, ntikibara amasaha cyangwa intego. Ukwezi kubarwa rimwe, waba warabwirije iminota mike cyangwa umunsi wose, kandi waba wemeza ko wagize uruhare mu murimo cyangwa wandika amasaha nk'umupayiniya. Ibimenyetso ntibisubira kuri zeru cyangwa ngo bishingire ku mezi akurikirana, bityo kuruhuka kubera uburwayi, ingendo cyangwa igihe kigoye nta cyo bigukuraho; ukwezi gukurikira ugize uruhare mu murimo kurabarwa. Urukurikirane rwawe ni urundi kandi ntirwigera rugira ingaruka ku bimenyetso byawe. Umwaka wose ubara imyaka y'umurimo ifite nibura amezi 10 yo kugira uruhare mu murimo, bityo amezi abiri utagiyemo mu mwaka w'umurimo ntabarwa nabi. Kubera ko buri kwezi kubarwa rimwe gusa, urwego rwo hejuru, Imaragarita, rumara imyaka. Ni ko bigenewe.

entries.question: Buri kimenyetso kibara iki, kandi kuki ukwezi kutabaruwe?

content.text: Gutangaza Ubutumwa Bwiza kibara amezi wandikiyemo igihe cyangwa wemeje ko wagize uruhare mu murimo. Umwaka wose kibara imyaka y'umurimo ifite nibura amezi 10 nk'ayo. Raporo zoherejwe kibara amezi raporo yayo wayohereje uvuye muri WitnessWork cyangwa wemeje ko yamaze koherezwa. Witeguye kibara amezi afite Gahunda, umunsi wa Gahunda ugeze. Amagambo meza kibara amezi afite gusura aho waganiriye n'umuntu; gusura Ntari mu rugo ntibibarwa. Gusubira gusura kibara amezi wasubiyemo gusura umuntu wari warasuye mbere. Ubutaha kibara amezi afite Gusubirayo gufite ingingo. Kuguma mu itumanaho kibara amezi menshi atandukanye waganiriyemo n'umuntu umwe, imbonankubone, kuri telefoni cyangwa mu rwandiko. Babiri babiri kibara amezi mugenzi yagiye nawe muri Gahunda cyangwa Gusubirayo, kandi kigaragara gusa aho Buddies iboneka. Niba ukwezi kutabaruwe: amasaha yimuwe n'uburyo bwo kwimura ntabarwa wenyine, Gahunda ibarwa gusa umunsi wayo ugeze, kandi Babiri babiri bisaba mugenzi wasubije Ndagenda. Ibimenyetso by'inshuro imwe bigaragaza ibya mbere: icyigisho cyawe cya mbere cya Bibiliya, na mugenzi wawe wa mbere.

entries.question: Bagenzi banjye babona iki, ibisubizo bikora bite, kandi nahagarika nte gusangiza ibimenyetso cyangwa imenyesha ryabyo?

content.text: Bagenzi bawe babona ibimenyetso ufite, buri kimwe ku rwego rwacyo rwo hejuru, iyo bafunguye urupapuro rwawe muri Buddies. Ntibigera babona iterambere ryawe, imibare, amatariki, cyangwa ibimenyetso utaragira. Mu buryo bwo kurinda amakuru, Icyigisho cya mbere cya Bibiliya ntigisangizwa. Kugira ngo uhagarike gusangiza ibimenyetso, zimya Ibimenyetso mu Igenamiterere rya Buddies. Iyo mugenzi abonye ikimenyetso gishya, ubona imenyesha ririmo izina rye n'ikimenyetso, nka “Levi yabonye ikimenyetso” hamwe na “Umwaka wose, Ifeza” hepfo yaryo; rikande kugira ngo ufungure urupapuro rwe. Ubona imenyesha rimwe gusa kuri buri mugenzi ku munsi, kandi ibimenyetso bikurikira uwo munsi biza bucece mu nzogera y'amamenyesha. Ibimenyetso byabonetse mu mateka yinjijwe cyangwa yagaruwe, n'ibimenyetso by'inshuro imwe, ntibitangazwa. Kugira ngo ukomeze mugenzi mu mutima, fungura urupapuro rwe muri Buddies, ukande kimwe mu bimenyetso bye, maze uhitemo igisubizo: 🎉, 🎊, 🔥, 👏, 👍, cyangwa 🙌. Ushobora gusubiza kuri buri kimenyetso rimwe; guhitamo ikindi gisubizo gisimbuza icya mbere. Uwo mugenzi gusa ni we ubona uwasubije, kandi nta kindi cyoherezwa: nta butumwa, kandi nta bimenyetso byawe. Niba nta interineti, igisubizo cyawe cyoherezwa usubiye kuri interineti. Iyo mugenzi asubije ku kimenyetso cyawe, ubona imenyesha nka “Anna yasubije 🔥 ku kimenyetso cyawe,” rimwe gusa kuri buri mugenzi ku munsi, kandi igisubizo kigaragara mu nzogera y'amamenyesha no mu gihe ufunguye icyo kimenyetso. Kugira ngo uhagarike imenyesha ry'ibimenyetso bishya n'ibisubizo kuri igikoresho, zimya Imenyesha ry'ibimenyetso mu Igenamiterere rya Buddies; byombi biracyagaragara mu nzogera y'amamenyesha. Iyo Erekana ibimenyetso izimye, ntushobora gusubiza, kandi ibisubizo ku bimenyetso byawe ntibigaragara.

entries.question: Ibimenyetso bishya n'ibisubizo bya bagenzi banjye bigaragara he?

content.text: Mu nzogera y'amamenyesha iri kuri Ahabanza, munsi ya Ibivuye kuri bagenzi bawe, munsi y'ikintu cyose gitegereje igisubizo cyawe. Ikimenyetso gishya cya mugenzi cyerekana ikimenyetso gifite ibisubizo bitandatu: 🎉, 🎊, 🔥, 👏, 👍, na 🙌. Kanda kimwe kugira ngo umukomeze mu mutima ako kanya. Nyuma yaho, umurongo werekana ibyo wohereje; kanda Hindura kugira ngo uhitemo ikindi. Kanda umurongo cyangwa ikimenyetso cyawo kugira ngo ukibone ku ecran yose, kiranzwe Gishya niba utari wakibonye. Ibimenyetso byinshi bya mugenzi umwe mu munsi umwe bisangira umurongo umwe. Iyo mugenzi asubije ku kimenyetso cyawe, kikande kugira ngo ufungure ikimenyetso cyawe hamwe n'ibisubizo bya buri mugenzi. Amakuru ya bagenzi ntiyongera ku mubare utukura uri ku nzogera cyangwa ku kimenyetso cya porogaramu; akadomo gato ku nzogera bisobanura ko hari ikintu gishya kivuye kuri bagenzi bawe. Rivuga gusa Uyu munsi, Iki cyumweru, cyangwa Mbere, ntirivuga igihe. Rikureho ukoresheje X cyangwa Kuraho byose, cyangwa ureke rikurweho ubwaryo nyuma y'iminsi 30. Rigaragara gusa kuri bagenzi bawe ba none, aho Buddies iboneka hose, kuri iPhone, iPad na Android, kandi gusa mu gihe Erekana ibimenyetso ifunguye. Kugira ngo uhagarike amenyesha ariko ugumane amakuru mu nzogera, zimya Imenyesha ry'ibimenyetso mu Igenamiterere rya Buddies. Niba nta interineti, igisubizo cyawe kirabikwa kandi cyoherezwa usubiye kuri interineti. Iyo wowe ubona ikimenyetso gishya kandi usangiza ibimenyetso na bagenzi bawe, ikarita y'Ikimenyetso gishya ivuga uzakibona, nka “Ben na Grace bazakibona.” Kugira ngo uhagarike gusangiza ibimenyetso, zimya Ibimenyetso mu Igenamiterere rya Buddies.

entries.question: Nshobora gutakaza ibimenyetso byanjye, kubimurira ku gikoresho gishya, cyangwa kubihisha?

content.text: Ibimenyetso ni urwibutso: iyo ufite kimwe, kiguma, nubwo wasiba nyuma igihe, gusura cyangwa gahunda biri inyuma yacyo, cyangwa mugenzi akagenda. Iterambere rijya ku rwego rukurikira naryo rirabikwa iyo uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru buvuze gusiba amakuru ya kera. Ibimenyetso byawe bihuzwa hagati y'ibikoresho byawe na iCloud Sync kandi bishyirwa muri dosiye z'ububiko, bityo kugarura ububiko kuri telefoni nshya biragarura. Iyo amateka yinjijwe cyangwa yagaruwe agera ku bimenyetso bishya, byongerwa bucece hamwe n'incamake imwe aho kwishimirwa kimwe kimwe, cyangwa nta ncamake na nke iyo winjije cyangwa ugarura mu gihe ushyiraho WitnessWork. Kugira ngo uhishe ibimenyetso, fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Inkurikirane n'Ibimenyetso maze uzimye Erekana ibimenyetso. Ibyo bibihisha hose, harimo no kuri bagenzi bawe no mu byishimo, nta kubyibagirwa; ubifunguye bwongera bikagaruka.

entries.question: Nkurikirana nte ibirometero?

content.text: Kurikirana ibirometero ni ubushake kandi bihari ku bwoko bwose bw'ababwiriza. Subiza Yego ku ikarita "Gukurikirana ibirometero?" yo ku Ahabanza, cyangwa ufungure Kurikirana ibirometero muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Umubwiriza. Hanyuma ongeraho imodoka yawe ya mbere; izina ni ryo ryonyine rikenewe. Andika urugendo ukoresheje Andika urugendo ku ikarita y'Ibirometero yo ku Ahabanza, kuri buto Ongeraho, cyangwa ku ecran y'Ibirometero. Andika intera (fungura Kugenda no kugaruka kugira ngo yikube kabiri) cyangwa uhindukire kuri Igipimo cy'ibirometero wandike ibipimo byo gutangira no kurangira. Igipimo cyo gutangira cyuzuzwa kuva ku gipimo cya nyuma ry'iyo modoka. Ingendo ntizishobora gushyirwaho amatariki yo mu gihe kizaza. Kanda urugendo kugira ngo urebe amakuru yarwo, cyangwa urukande igihe kirekire kugira ngo urihindure, urwandike nanone uyu munsi, urusangize cyangwa urusibe.

entries.question: Igiciro cya lisansi giteganyijwe kibarwa gite, kandi bigenda bite iyo ibiciro bya lisansi bihindutse?

content.text: Igiciro cya lisansi giteganyijwe ni intera ÷ ikoreshwa rya lisansi ry'imodoka × igiciro cya lisansi yayo, hakoreshejwe agaciro gakurikizwa ku itariki ya buri rugendo. Kigaragara gusa iyo imodoka ifite ikoreshwa rya lisansi kandi lisansi yayo ifite igiciro; ingendo zitagira byombi zirasigara kandi raporo irabivuga. Igiciro cya lisansi gisangiwe n'imodoka zose zikoresha iyo lisansi. Iyo uhinduye igiciro cyangwa ikoreshwa rya lisansi ry'imodoka, hitamo Guhera ku itariki kugira ngo bikurikizwe guhera kuri uwo munsi (ingendo za mbere zigumana agaciro ka kera) cyangwa Kosora agaciro ka none kugira ngo ukosore ikosa, ibyo binavugurura ingendo zashize zakoresheje agaciro. Buri lisansi na buri modoka bigira amateka; kanda igihe kirekire inyandiko kugira ngo uyisibe. Umubare ni ugereranya gusa. Niba usubizwa amafaranga, umubare nyawo ubarwa n'ukusubiza.

entries.question: Nshobora gukoresha kilometero, litiro, cyangwa L/100 km?

content.text: Yego. Fungura Ibirometero → Igenamiterere (agashushanyo k'ibikoresho) → Ibipimo. Intera ishobora kuba mayili cyangwa kilometero, kandi ikoreshwa rya lisansi rishobora kuba mpg (US), mpg (UK), L/100 km, cyangwa km/L. Auto ikurikiza akarere k'igikoresho cyawe. Lisansi ihabwa igiciro kuri galoni na mpg (US) no kuri litiro n'ibindi byose. Ifaranga rikurikiza akarere k'igikoresho cyawe. Guhindura ibipimo bihindura gusa uko imibare yerekanwa; ingendo zawe ntizihindurwa.

entries.question: Nsangiza nte cyangwa nohereza nte raporo yanjye y'ibirometero?

content.text: Fungura Ibirometero, uhitemo Umunsi, Icyumweru, Ukwezi, cyangwa Umwaka (umwaka w'umurimo, Nzeri kugeza Kanama), hanyuma ukoreshe imyambi cyangwa unyuze urutoki kugira ngo uhitemo igihe. Kanda buto yo gusangiza hejuru kugira ngo Kopi raporo, uyisangize nk'inyandiko, cyangwa Sohora CSV ku buryo bwa spreadsheet. Inyandiko igaragaza ibiteranyo, ibiteranyo by'imodoka imwe imwe iyo ufite imodoka irenze imwe, na buri rugendo uretse mu Mwaka. CSV ifite umurongo umwe ku rugendo ufite imodoka, ibipimo bya odometer, intera, icyitonderwa, lisansi, ikoreshwa rya lisansi, igiciro n'igiciro giteganyijwe. Ibyitonderwa by'ingendo birimo, bityo ubisuzume mbere yo kohereza. Kugira ngo usangize urugendo rumwe, urufungure ukande buto yo gusangiza.

entries.question: Itandukaniro riri hagati yo kubika mu bubiko no gusiba imodoka ni irihe?

content.text: Fungura Ibirometero → Igenamiterere, ukande imodoka, uhitemo Ububiko cyangwa Siba…. Kubika mu bubiko bihisha imodoka ku ngendo nshya ariko bigakomeza ingendo zayo muri raporo zawe; uyigarure mu bubiko igihe icyo ari cyo cyose uciye mu Imodoka zabitswe. Gusiba bikuraho imodoka n'ingendo zayo zose ku bikoresho byose bihuza n'iki, kandi ntibishobora gusubirwamo. Gusiba lisansi bikuraho amateka y'ibiciro byayo, bityo imodoka zikoresha iyo lisansi zireka kwerekana igiciro giteganyijwe.

entries.question: Ikarita ku ecran y'Ibirometero igaragaza iki?

content.text: Fungura ecran y'Ibirometero uhitemo Icyumweru, Ukwezi, cyangwa Umwaka. Ikarita igaragaza uko wagenze kure buri munsi, cyangwa buri kwezi k'umwaka w'umurimo (Nzeri kugeza Kanama). Iyo imodoka irenze imwe ifite ingendo muri icyo gihe, buri murongo ugabanywamo ku modoka, hakoreshejwe amabara ari iruhande rw'igiteranyo cya buri modoka. Kanda umurongo kugira ngo ufungure uwo munsi cyangwa ukwezi urebe ingendo zaho. Ubwo buryo bwa Umunsi nta karita bufite, kandi igihe kitagira ingendo nta kigaragaza. Imirongo igaragaza intera, si igiciro giteganyijwe.

entries.question: Ibirometero byanjye birahuzwa, kandi bikora kuri Android?

content.text: Ibirometero bikora kuri iOS na Android. Imodoka, lisansi, ibiciro n'ingendo bihuzwa hagati y'ibikoresho bya iOS na iCloud Sync, ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga, kandi bishyirwa muri backup zo muri Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura ku mbuga zombi. Kuri Android bihuzwa hagati y'ibikoresho bya Android na Google Drive Sync, na yo ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga. Hagati ya iPhone n'igikoresho cya Android, koresha backup. Ibirometero ntibisangizwa na Buddies na rimwe kandi ntibigaragara kuri kalendari yawe cyangwa Raporo y'umurimo.

entries.question: Nzimya nte cyangwa nfungura nte kurikirana ibirometero?

content.text: Koresha akuma Kurikirana ibirometero muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Umubwiriza. Kuzimya bihisha ikarita yo ku Ahabanza, igikorwa Andika urugendo, na ecran y'Ibirometero, ariko bigakomeza ingendo zawe; fungura nanone byose bigaruka. Niba warahisemo Oya, murakoze ku ikarita yo ku Ahabanza, aka kuma kayifungura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Kugira ngo usibe ibirometero byawe, fungura Ibirometero → Igenamiterere → Siba amakuru yose y'ibirometero. Ibi bisiba ku bikoresho byose bihuza n'iki kandi ntibishobora gusubirwamo. Ushobora kandi guhisha ikarita yo ku Ahabanza gusa ukoresheje Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Ekara y'ahabanza.

entries.question: Nshobora kugarura bagenzi banjye ku kindi gikoresho cyangwa mu backup?

content.text: Kuri iPhone na iPad, urufunguzo rwawe rwo guhisha rwa Buddies rubikwa muri iCloud Keychain, bityo Buddies igarura amasano yayo ku kindi gikoresho gikoresha Apple Account imwe, cyangwa nyuma yo kongera gushyiraho WitnessWork, iyo ihuza. Kuri Android, serivisi za Google Play zibika urufunguzo: rugaruka iyo wongeye gushyiraho WitnessWork kuri telefoni imwe mu gihe backup ya Google ifunguye (Igenamiterere → Google → Backup), kandi iyo ufite gufunga ecran, runabikwa, rwahishwe impande zombi, muri backup yawe ya Google, bityo rushobora kugaruka iyo utegura telefoni nshya uvuye kuri iyo backup. Nta gufunga ecran, urufunguzo rukomeza kuba kuri iyo telefoni. Ibikoresho bya Android ntibisangira urufunguzo rumwe nk'uko iCloud Keychain ibikora, bityo buri gikoresho cya Android, na iPhone na telefoni ya Android, bifite amasano yabyo bwite ya Buddies. Dosiye zisanzwe za backup ya WitnessWork ntizirimo urufunguzo rwo guhisha. Kugarura Buddies bitandukanye na iCloud Sync y'Umuterankunga ku nyandiko z'umurimo. Niba urufunguzo rutaboneka, cyangwa wakoresheje Siba amakuru yanjye ya Buddies, ongera uhuze ukoresheje ubutumire bushya. Bika inyandiko zawe bwite muri backup ukwazo.

entries.question: Ni gute namenya umubare w'amasaha nsigaje muri uku kwezi cyangwa mu mwaka?

content.text: Open the Progress tab from the bottom bar. Igishushanyo mbonera cy'ukwezi kigaragaza igihe n'amasaha asigaye muri uku kwezi. Abapayiniya barashobora kwimukira kuri sub-screen y'umwaka kugira ngo barebe iterambere ry'intego y'umwaka, igihe kugeza ubu, amasaha asigaye, hamwe n'isesengura rya buri kwezi ugereranije amasaha nyayo na teganyo.

entries.question: Ni gute namenya niba ndi imbere cyangwa inyuma y'intego yanjye y'isaha?

content.text: Fungura Iterambere ukoresheje umurongo wo hasi. Ecran ya Ukwezi igaragaza intego yawe ya buri munsi kugira ngo urebe niba uri ku murongo mu kwezi kwa none. Abapayiniya bashobora guhindukirira ecran ya Umwaka, aho ikarita y'Umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo igaragaza uko uri imbere cyangwa inyuma y'Intego yawe y'umwaka uyu munsi, naho umurongo wa buri kwezi ugaragaza uko uko kwezi kwagenze ugereranyije n'intego yako.

entries.question: Nasoma nte ikarita y'Umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo?

content.text: Fungura Iterambere uhindukire kuri Umwaka. Niba imimerere yawe ifite Intego y'umwaka, nk'umupayiniya w'igihe cyose, ikarita y'Umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo igaragara munsi y'intambwe zawe. Umurongo w'imvi ucagaguye ni aho Intego yawe y'umwaka ikugeza mu mpera za buri kwezi. Wubakwa ku ntego ya buri kwezi ubwayo, bityo gushyirwaho hagati mu mwaka cyangwa ukwezi k'ubupayiniya bwungirije bibihindura, ariko Intego y'ukwezi wihinduriye wowe ntibihindura. Umurongo w'icyatsi ni igihe cyawe kugeza ubu, kibarwa nk'uko Raporo yawe y'umurimo ibarwa, harimo imbibi z'inyongera za buri kwezi. Umurongo w'icyatsi ucagaguye wongeraho igihe wateganyije. Umurongo urabagirana gato ni umwaka w'umurimo ushize, ugaragara iyo warawanditsemo igihe, kandi umubare uri ku mpera yawo ni igiteranyo cy'umwaka ushize. Niba umurongo urenze cyane Intego yawe y'umwaka, umwanya uri hejuru y'intego ushushanywa ku gipimo gifunze (logarithmic) kugira ngo amezi ari munsi akomeze gusomeka. Kanda ufate ku ikarita, hanyuma unyuze urutoki, kugira ngo urebe ibiteranyo by'ukwezi kose. "Uri imbere y'umuvuduko" bigereranya igihe cyawe n'aho umurongo w'intego uri uyu munsi. Munsi y'ikarita, buri kwezi gifite umurongo: ukomeye ni igihe cyanditswe, woroheje ni igihe cy'inyongera, ufite imirongo ni gahunda, ufite akarongo ku ntego y'uko kwezi. Ibisobanuro biri hejuru y'amezi bisobanura ibyo bimenyetso, naho inkingi z'Amasaha na Ugereranyije n'intego zitanga imibare. Imirongo yose ikoresha igipimo kimwe, bityo ushobora kugereranya amezi. Nta Ntego y'umwaka, ubona imirongo y'amezi ariko ntubona ikarita. Niba ukwezi kugaragara nabi, kanda ukufate kugira ngo uhindure imimerere cyangwa intego yako. Ikarita ishushanywa ku gikoresho cyawe ikoresheje inyandiko zawe bwite kandi ntisangizwa.

entries.question: Nshobora kwerekana igihe nka "1h 30m" aho kuba "1.5"?

content.text: Yego. Fungura Preferences → Appearance hanyuma uhitemo igihe ushaka. Aya mashusho yombi aboneka ahantu hose hagaragara.

entries.question: Ese nshobora gutangira icyumweru ku wa mbere aho kuba ku cyumweru?

content.text: Yego. Ibyifuzo → isura bigufasha guhitamo umunsi wa mbere w'icyumweru. Iri tegeko rireba ingengabihe y'icyumweru, ingengabihe n'ibindi bikorwa byose by'icyumweru.

entries.question: Ese nshobora gukoresha uburyo bw'umwijima cyangwa uburyo bw'urumuri?

content.text: Yego. Fungura Preferences → Appearance → Color Scheme hanyuma uhitemo System, Light, or Dark. Porogaramu ihagarika gukurikirana imiterere ya telefoni yawe hanyuma ukoreshe iyo uhitamo.

entries.question: Ese nshobora guhindura indangamuntu ya porogaramu ya USU?

content.text: Amashusho asimburwa ya porogaramu ni inyungu y'Umuterankunga kuri iOS. Fungura Igenamiterere → Kwihitiramo → App Icon uhitemo ishusho isimbura. Amashusho asimburwa ya porogaramu ntaboneka kuri Android.

entries.question: Nshobora kongera gutumiza amakarita kuri ecran yanjye yo mu rugo?

content.text: Yego. Fungura Preferences → Home Screen kugirango wereke, guhisha, no kongera gutunganya amakarita. Home Amakuru Amakuru Mashya Rayon Sports izakomeza gukurikirana imiterere y'ikipe y'igihugu Amavubi.

entries.question: Nshobora guhindura uko utubuto dukurikirana?

content.text: Yego. Fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Uko utubuto dutondetse ukoreshe imyambi yo hejuru no hasi iri iruhande rwa buri gikoresho cy'ikibuto, cyangwa ukande igihe kirekire ku izina ry'ikibuto kugira ngo ukimure hejuru cyangwa hasi. Uko gukurikirana gushya gukoreshwa ako kanya ku murongo wo hasi ku matelefoni no ku murongo w'ibumoso kuri tablet, kuri iOS na Android. Utubuto dushobora gutondekwa ariko ntidushobora guhishwa. WitnessWork igifungukira ku Ahabanza, kandi Iterambere rigaragara gusa ku nshingano zandika amasaha; rigumana umwanya waryo mu gutondeka iyo uhinduye inshingano. Kuri iPad, ibimenyetso bya Command-nomero bya clavier na byo bikurikiza uko watondetse. Gutondeka ni ihitamo, bityo kubikwa muri backup kandi bihuzwa na iCloud iyo guhuza gufunguye; ntibihindura inyandiko zawe zose. Kugira ngo usubire uko byari bimeze, subiza utubuto kuri Ahabanza, Abantu, Iterambere, Ingengabihe. Niba gutondeka bidahinduka, ongera utangize porogaramu hanyuma ukoreshe Uracyakeneye ubufasha? hepfo.

entries.question: Why was my timer rounded to the nearest 5 minutes?

content.text: Iyo yari imyitwarire ya kera. Version ziherutse kuzigama igihe nyacyo cyo guhagarara mugihe uhagaritse isaha, nta kuzunguruka. Niba ugifite iminota 5 yo kuzenguruka, vugurura porogaramu kuri verisiyo iheruka.

entries.question: Ese nshobora kongeramo inyandiko ku gihe cyo kwiyandikisha?

content.text: Yego. Mu gihe wongeyeho cyangwa uhinduye inyandiko y'igihe, ushobora gushyiramo inyuguti (urugero: "Gutanga ubuhamya bw'ikarita" cyangwa "gukata ngufi"). You can also tag entries with categories so similar entries stay grouped in your time reports.

entries.question: Ndi umupayiniya udasanzwe, kuki porogaramu inyereka intego y'umwaka?

content.text: Abapayiniya badasanzwe ntibagira intego y'umwaka. If yours appears, open Preferences → Publisher and turn off the annual goal. Your monthly goal remains in place and the annual bar on the Progress tab's Year sub-screen will be hidden.

entries.question: Are LDC and other credit hours included in my totals?

content.text: Yego. Amasaha y'inguzanyo abarwa ku isaha yawe ya buri kwezi. Mu mwaka w'umurimo, amasaha 55 y'inguzanyo buri kwezi arabarwa, hakurikijwe ibipimo byatangajwe n'ishami. Buri kintu cyose kiri hejuru y'igipimo kiracyashyirwa ku rutonde rw'ibicuruzwa, ariko ntikijya mu gipimo cy'umwaka.

entries.question: Will my time entries or plans shift days if I travel between timezones?

content.text: Oya. Kuva mu ivugurura rya Mata 2026, igihe cyose kwinjira na gahunda bihujwe n'itariki ya kalendari yigenga, bityo kugenda cyangwa kwambuka umupaka w'izuba ntibizamura kwinjiza ku wundi munsi. Older entries created before that update are migrated automatically the first time you open the new version. Niba ubonye inyandiko ku munsi utari wo nyuma yo kuvugurura, nyamuneka wohereze raporo ya bug hanyuma tuzareba.

entries.question: Nteganya nte mu mezi menshi cyangwa nkareba umwaka wanjye w'umurimo wose?

content.text: Ingengabihe ifite uburyo bubiri bwo kureba; hindura hagati yabwo ukoresheje buto ziri hejuru. Ukwezi kigaragaza ibyumweru byawe nk'ikalendari imwe unyuzamo urutoki udahagarara ku mpera y'ukwezi, bityo ushobora gutegura uku kwezi n'ukuzakurikiraho icyarimwe. Ukwezi urimo gusoma guhora kurabagirana naho utundi tugahera, naho ikarita iri hejuru ya kalendari igaragaza intego y'ukwezi ukwo: igihe cyanditswe n'igiteganyijwe (kiriho imirongo) ugereranyije n'intego yawe, igihe wanditse, no kumenya niba uri imbere cyangwa inyuma ya gahunda zawe. Yikande kugira ngo urebe uko intego yuzuye, umuvuduko wa gahunda n'Umufasha. Buri munsi ugaragaza igihe wateganyije, cyangwa igihe wanditse iyo hari icyo wanditse. Kanda umunsi kugira ngo ubone cyangwa uhindure, cyangwa uwukande ugafate kugira ngo wongereho igihe cyangwa uwuteganye. Umwaka ugaragaza amezi cumi n'abiri y'umwaka w'umurimo (kuva muri Nzeri kugeza muri Kanama), buri munsi ufite ibara nka kalendari, hamwe n'intego yawe y'umwaka hejuru niba uyifite. Kanda ukwezi, cyangwa ufungure intoki zombi, kugira ngo ukwegere; funga intoki zombi muri Ukwezi kugira ngo usubire inyuma. Umurongo ufite izina ugaragaza aho umwaka w'umurimo umwe urangirira ukurikiraho utangirira; uwukande kugira ngo urebe uwo mwaka. Koresha imyambi cyangwa unyuze urutoki kugira ngo uhindure imyaka, hanyuma ukande Uyu munsi kugira ngo usubire. Uburyo bwombi bugaragaza gusa ibiri mu nyandiko zawe; guhindura uburyo bwo kureba nta cyo bisangiza.

entries.question: Ni iki kiri ku rupapuro rwa Gahunda, kandi nyihindura nte?

content.text: Kanda umunsi ku Ingengabihe, hanyuma ukande imwe muri Gahunda zawo, cyangwa ukande Gahunda ku Ahabanza, kugira ngo uyifungure. Urupapuro rwayo rugaragaza itariki, igihe itangirira n'igihe irangirira (hamwe n'itariki y'umunsi ukurikira niba irenga saa sita z'ijoro) cyangwa Igihe cyose kuri Gahunda idafite igihe, igihe imara, Ubwoko bwayo, inshuro isubirwamo, ahantu, n'icyitonderwa; kanda ahantu kugira ngo uhafungure muri Maps. Kugira ngo uhindure Gahunda, kanda Hindura (ikaramu). Kuri gahunda yisubiramo, kubika bibaza niba impinduka ireba gusa iyi tariki, iyi n'izizakurikiraho, cyangwa amatariki yose. Ibindi (•••) birimo Kora kopi, Andika nk'igihe (ku munsi w'uyu munsi cyangwa mbere), Fungura muri Maps, Koporora aderesi, Koporora icyitonderwa, na Siba. Hamwe na Buddies, urupapuro runerekana abo watumiye n'uko buri wese yasubije, hamwe n'uwo ari we wese wasabye kwifatanya, hamwe na Tumira. Kanda Tumira bagenzi kugira ngo utumire umuntu ako kanya mu gihe Gahunda ikiri imbere; bahabwa itariki, igihe, umutwe, ahantu n'icyitonderwa. Kugira ngo ukureho umuntu, koresha Hindura. Kuri Gahunda wifatanyije binyuze ku butumire bwa mugenzi wawe, urupapuro rugaragaza uwayitegetse n'igisubizo cyawe. Hindura hagati ya Ndagenda na Sinshobora igihe icyo ari cyo cyose kugeza umunsi umwe nyuma ya Gahunda: Sinshobora ikura Gahunda ku ngengabihe yawe, naho Ndagenda ikayigarura.

entries.question: Nshobora guteganya amasaha nta gutoranya igihe?

content.text: Yego. Ku ifishi ya Gahunda, kanda buto Bimara igihe kingana iki? iruhande rw'itariki. Hitamo Amasaha gusa kugira ngo uteganye amasaha y'uwo munsi nta gihe, cyangwa Igihe cyuzuye kugira ngo uhitemo igihe utangirira n'igihe urangirira; amasaha arakusanywa kuri wowe. Gahunda nshya zifungukira muri ubwo buryo wakoresheje bwa nyuma, bityo uburyo busanzwe bwawe buba bwiteguye ubutaha. Gahunda ya Amasaha gusa igaragaza Igihe cyose ku Ingengabihe yawe kandi ibarwa ku ntego zawe nk'izindi Gahunda zose. Menyesha njyewe ifunguye, iguhumuriza saa 8:00 z'igitondo cy'uwo munsi aho kuba mbere y'igihe cyo gutangira. Bagenzi wawe utumira babona umunsi n'igihe imara, nta saha. Kugira ngo uyihe igihe nyuma, hindura Gahunda uhindukire kuri Igihe cyuzuye. Niba ikindi gikoresho cyawe kigikoresha verisiyo ishaje ya WitnessWork, kigaragaza Gahunda saa sita kugeza kivuguruwe.

entries.question: Ese nshobora gukuraho cyangwa gukuraho inyandiko imwe y'ikinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe?

content.text: Yego. Ku Ingengabihe, kanda umunsi, hanyuma ukande gahunda kugira ngo uyifungure. Kugira ngo uhindure gusa iyo tariki, kanda Hindura (ikaramu), kora impinduka zawe, ubike, hanyuma uhitemo Gusa kuri iyi tariki. Guhindura Ubwoko, umutwe cyangwa ahantu ku itariki imwe bituma iyo tariki iba gahunda yayo y'inshuro imwe. Kugira ngo ukureho gusa iyo tariki, kanda Ibindi (•••), hanyuma Siba → Siba iyi gahunda. Gahunda yawe yisubiramo ikomeza uko iri ku yindi minsi yose.

entries.question: How do I mark a day I'm not going out without breaking my repeat plan?

content.text: Kanda gahunda iri kuri uwo munsi ku Ingengabihe kugira ngo uyifungure, kanda Ibindi (•••), hanyuma Siba → Siba iyi gahunda. Kora ibi kuri buri gahunda yo kuri uwo munsi. Hakurwaho gusa uwo munsi, kandi gahunda yisubiramo ikomeza guhera ku munsi ukurikira. Kugira ngo ujye kubwiriza mu kindi gihe kuri uwo munsi, kanda Hindura, uyihindure, hanyuma uhitemo Gusa kuri iyi tariki iyo ubitse.

entries.question: Nshobora guteganya ibikorwa birenze kimwe ku munsi umwe?

content.text: Yego. Umunsi ushobora kugira gahunda nyinshi uko ushaka, z'inshuro imwe, zisubiramo, cyangwa zombi, nko kubwiriza buri wa gatanu mu gitondo n'icyigisho cya Bibiliya buri wa gatanu nimugoroba. Gahunda zose zo ku munsi zirakusanywa: igihe giteganyijwe cy'uwo munsi ku ngengabihe, igihe gisigaye gutegurwa, n'igiteranyo cyawe giteganyijwe byose bibara buri imwe. Kugira ngo wongereho indi gahunda, kanda umunsi ku Ingengabihe, hanyuma ukande + iruhande rwa Gahunda. Kugira ngo usimbuke gahunda yisubiramo ku munsi umwe, uyifungure, kanda Ibindi (•••), hanyuma Siba → Siba iyi gahunda; indi minsi yawe ikomeza uko iri. Kugira ngo uyihindure ku munsi umwe gusa, kanda Hindura uhitemo Gusa kuri iyi tariki iyo ubitse. Mbere, gahunda z'inshuro imwe zasimbuzaga gahunda zisubiramo z'umunsi. Igihe wavugururaga, iminsi byabayeho yashyizweho yo gusimbuka gahunda yisubiramo, bityo ibiteranyo byawe ntibyahindutse. Niba umunsi ugaragaza igihe kirenze icyo utekereza, uwukande usibe gahunda udakeneye. Gahunda zikomeza ku gikoresho cyawe, zihuzwa na iCloud Sync niba wayifunguye, kandi umunsi wazo, igihe n'uburebure gusa ni byo bisangizwa bagenzi bawe niba ukoresha Buddies.

entries.question: WitnessWork ishobora kuntegurira ukwezi kwanjye?

content.text: Yego. Mu gihe cyo gutegura, niba wandika amasaha kandi ufite intego y'ukwezi, ubona incamake yihuse y'Umufasha: hitamo iminsi ujyaho kubwiriza kenshi, ugabanye intego yawe kuri iyo minsi y'uku kwezi, cyangwa ukwezi gukurikira niba hasigaye iminsi itarenze irindwi. Kanda umunsi uwo ari wo wose kugira ngo uhindure gahunda yawo ukoresheje slider, cyangwa uteganye umunsi wowe ubwawe. Kanda Ongeraho kuri ingengabihe yanjye kugira ngo uzibike nka gahunda ku Ingengabihe, aho ushobora guhindura cyangwa gusiba iyo ari yo yose, cyangwa ukande Nzateganya nyuma kugira ngo ukomeze nta gahunda. Iminsi y'icyumweru utahisemo iba iminsi y'ikiruhuko, bityo Umufasha ntazagusaba gahunda kuri yo; hindura ibi igihe icyo ari cyo cyose muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Gahunda → Kuboneka. Nyuma yo gutegura, uteganya ku Ingengabihe ukanda umunsi uwo ari wo wose, kandi Umufasha uriho agusaba gahunda igihe cyose ubuze ku ntego yawe. Gahunda zibikwa hamwe n'izindi nyandiko zawe kandi ntizibarwa ku raporo yawe; andika igihe ukoresha koko. Ababwiriza b'Ubwami batandika amasaha, n'umuntu wese udafite intego y'ukwezi, basimbuka iki gice ariko bashobora kongeraho gahunda bakoresheje Ingengabihe.

entries.question: WitnessWork ishobora kunyibutsa kwandika igihe cy'umunsi nateganyije?

content.text: Yego. Jya kuri Amahitamo → Gahunda, ufungure Unyibutse kwandika igihe, maze uhitemo isaha ya Unyibutse saa (saa mbiri z'ijoro keretse uyihinduye). Niba umunsi ufite gahunda ariko nta gihe cyanditse, uhabwa urwibutso rumwe kuri iyo saa nyuma y'uko gahunda z'uwo munsi zirangira: gahunda ya mu gitondo ikwibutsa nimugoroba, naho gahunda igikomeje ku isaha wahisemo ikwibutsa bukeye. Gahunda nyinshi zo ku munsi umwe zitanga urwibutso rumwe, kandi iyo inyibutsa z'iminsi ibiri zigomba kuza icyarimwe, zihuzwa. Kwandika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose cy'uwo munsi bihagarika urwibutso rwawo kandi bikuraho urwo wari wamaze guhabwa; gukuraho gahunda z'uwo munsi cyangwa kuzimya iri genamiterere nabyo birabikora. Umunsi ufite gahunda idafite igihe ntukwibutsa, kandi iminsi wasibye mbere y'uko ufungura iri genamiterere ntirimo. Gukanda ku rwibutso bifungura Ongeraho igihe, itariki, igihe cyateganyijwe n'ubwoko byamaze kuzuzwa. Urwibutso kandi rugaragara mu nzogera ya Ahabanza mu cyumweru, nubwo amamenyesha ya sisitemu yaba azimye. Iri genamiterere rigaragara iyo wandika amasaha; Ababwiriza basanzwe babanza gufungura Andika amasaha yanjye. Kuyifungura bisaba uruhushya rw'amamenyesha, cyangwa bigufungurira igenamiterere rya telefoni yawe niba wari warabyanze. Inyibutsa zibarwa kuri telefoni yawe ukurikije gahunda zawe n'igihe cyawe, kandi ntizoherezwa ahandi. Buri gikoresho gitegura inyibutsa zacyo kugeza ku byumweru bibiri imbere, bityo fungura WitnessWork nibura buri byumweru bibiri kugira ngo zikomeze kuza. Niba wanditse igihe ku kindi gikoresho, fungura WitnessWork kuri iki kugira ngo gihagarike urwibutso rw'uwo munsi. Kuri Android, sisitemu ishobora gutinza urwibutso iminota mike kugira ngo ibike bateri. Niba inyibutsa zitaza, reba ko amamenyesha yemerewe WitnessWork mu igenamiterere rya telefoni yawe kandi ko Focus cyangwa Ntugire uwo unsuhuza (Do Not Disturb) bitazihagarika. Niba zikomeje kutaza, menyesha ikibazo ukoresheje Ikigo cy'ubufasha utavuze amazina cyangwa andi makuru bwite.

entries.question: Urukurikirane rukora rute?

content.text: Urukurikirane rwawe rugaragaza uko ukomeza gukurikiza gahunda ushyiraho. Ku bapayiniya no ku bandi banditse amasaha, buri munsi wari ufite gahunda wandikaho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose wongeraho umwe, nubwo wakwandika igihe kiri munsi y'icyo wateganyije. Iminsi idafite gahunda ntiyongera ku rukurikirane kandi ntiyarurangiza, bityo tegura iminsi ushaka kujya kubwiriza. Ku babwiriza, buri kwezi ugira uruhare mu murimo wongeraho kimwe, waba ugushyize ku Ahabanza cyangwa wandika igihe. Urukurikirane rwawe rugaragara ku mutwe wa Ahabanza no ku Mwirondoro wawe iyo rugeze kuri 3. Iyo kwandika umunsi bigejeje urukurikirane ku ntambwe nka 3, 5 cyangwa 10, hakinwa ibyishimo bigufi; indi minsi, no kwiyongera kuza mu bundi buryo, nko mu gihe cyanditswe kuri watch yawe cyangwa ku kindi gikoresho, bituma urumuri ruri kuri Ahabanza rwaka cyane. Iyo rwenda kurangira, rukande kuri Ahabanza kugira ngo wandike umunsi usigaye. Kugira ngo uhishe urukurikirane rwawe, zimya Erekana urukurikirane muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Inkurikirane n'Ibimenyetso.

entries.question: Urukurikirane rwanjye rurangira ryari, kandi nabigenza nte ngo rukomeze?

content.text: Umunsi wari ufite gahunda ushobora kwandikwa kugeza ku iherezo ry'umunsi ukurikiraho. Iyo bwije nta gihe cyanditswe, urukurikirane rwawe rurangira. Iyo rwenda kurangira, urumuri ruri kuri Ahabanza rugaragaza igihe gisigaye, kandi Urwibutso rw'urukurikirane ruza saa kumi n'ebyiri z'umugoroba ku munsi wa nyuma. Ku babwiriza, ukwezi gushobora kwandikwa kugeza ku iherezo ry'ukwezi gukurikira, kandi urwibutso ruza iminsi itatu mbere y'uko ukwezi kurangira. Niba udashobora kujya kubwiriza ku munsi wari ufite gahunda, kuraho gahunda z'uwo munsi hakiri kare: kanda buri imwe kuri Ingengabihe, ukande Ibindi (•••), hanyuma Siba → Siba iyi gahunda. Ku gahunda yisubiramo, itariki imwe gusa ni yo ikurwaho. Umunsi ukomeza kugira gahunda igihe cyose hari izisigaye kuri wo. Niba wagiye kubwiriza ariko ukibagirwa kwandika, ongeraho igihe kuri uwo munsi maze urukurikirane rwawe ruragaruka. Zimya Inyibutsa z'urukurikirane muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Inkurikirane n'Ibimenyetso. Zisaba ko amamenyesha yemerewe WitnessWork.

entries.question: Bagenzi banjye bashobora kubona urukurikirane rwanjye?

content.text: Yego, iyo rugeze kuri 3 kandi urusangiza. Bagenzi bawe babona umubare ku ikarita yawe mu rutonde rwa Buddies rwabo, ariko ntibabona igihe cyawe cyangwa raporo zawe. Rurarinzwe n'ibanga kuva ku gikoresho kimwe kugeza ku kindi (end-to-end) nk'ibindi usangiza. Kugira ngo uhagarike kurusangiza, fungura Igenamiterere rya Buddies ukuzimye Urukurikirane. Urukurikirane rwarangiye ruhagarara kugaragara kuri telefoni za bagenzi bawe nubwo porogaramu yawe itafunguwe kuva icyo gihe.

entries.question: Nshobora kuzimya inkurikirane?

content.text: Yego. Fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Inkurikirane n'Ibimenyetso maze uzimye Erekana urukurikirane. Urukurikirane rwawe ntirukigaragara kuri Ahabanza cyangwa ku mwirondoro wawe, nta cyishimira, Inyibutsa z'urukurikirane zirahagarara, kandi indamukanyo ya Ahabanza ntikibara iminsi ikurikiranye. Inkurikirane za bagenzi bawe nazo zirahishwa, kandi urwawe ntirukibasangizwa. Nta cyatakaye: urukurikirane rwawe ruva muri gahunda zawe n'igihe wandika, bityo iyo wongeye gufungura Erekana urukurikirane ruhita rugaragara, keretse rwarangiye hagati aho. Iri hitamo rikurikira ku bindi bikoresho byawe iyo guhuza byafunguwe. Kugira ngo uhishe n'ibimenyetso, zimya Erekana ibimenyetso kuri iyo ecran.

entries.question: Nteganya nte inzira ngufi y'aho nzahagarara uyu munsi?

content.text: Gutegura inzira ni ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga kuri iPhone, iPad na Android, kandi gikenera interineti. Ku Ahabanza, kanda Tegura inzira hejuru y'ikarita y'ibiganiro. Ushobora kandi gukanda itariki y'uyu munsi ku Ahabanza cyangwa muri Ingengabihe (kuri iPad, amakuru y'uyu munsi agaragara iruhande rwa kalendari), hanyuma ukande Tegura inzira y'uyu munsi. Igaragara iyo nibura ahantu habiri uhagarara hafite aho biri ku ikarita. Umuntu wese ashobora kuyifungura ngo arebe aho uhagarara uyu munsi; gushaka urukurikirane rugufi bikenera kuba Umuterankunga. Aho uhagarara ni gusubirayo kutarangiye kw'uyu munsi na gahunda z'uyu munsi. Gusubirayo byamaze gusubizwa no gusura uyu munsi, na gusubirayo kw'abantu warekeye, ntibirimo. Aho uhagarara hatagira aderesi cyangwa akamenyetso na ho ntihashyirwamo; ongeraho aderesi cyangwa ushyire akamenyetso ku muntu cyangwa ahantu gahunda iri kugira ngo hashyirwemo. Hitamo aho utangirira, haba aho uri ubu cyangwa kimwe mu bihagararwaho, kuraho ahantu uzasimbuka, hanyuma ukande Shakisha inzira ngufi. Inzira ishobora kugira ahantu hagera ku 10, kandi ushobora gutegura inzira zigera ku 10 mu masaha 24 yose. Urukurikirane ni urugendo rwihuta cyane hakurikijwe imodoka zo mu muhanda ubu. Ibihe bya gusubirayo na gahunda ntibitekerezwaho, bityo reba urukurikirane ugereranyije n'amasaha yose yagenwe. Niba nta nzira ibonetse, kuraho ahantu hatagerwa n'imodoka. Niba gutegura bitaboneka, ongera ugerageze nyuma. Gutegura inzira ntibihindura abantu bawe, gusubirayo cyangwa gahunda. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwihariye bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.

entries.question: Inzira yanjye ifungukira ite muri Apple Maps, Google Maps cyangwa Waze?

content.text: Inzira yawe ifungukira muri Ikarita isanzwe yo gukoresha wahisemo muri Igenamiterere → Amerekezo. Google Maps ifungura inzira yose nk'urugendo rumwe hamwe n'aho uhagarara hose ukurikije urukurikirane. Apple Maps ikora kimwe kuri iOS 18.4 cyangwa irenzeho; ku mavugurura ya kera ifungura ahantu hamwe icyarimwe. Waze ihora ifungura ahantu hamwe icyarimwe kuko amahuza yayo yemera aho ujya hamwe gusa. Iyo ahantu hafungurwa hamwe hamwe, kanda Genda aho uhagarara hajya 1, hanyuma usubire muri WitnessWork ukande buto nanone ku hantu hakurikira, cyangwa ukande umwambi uri iruhande rw'aho uhagarara hose. Buri rugendo rutangirira aho uri, bityo aho wahisemo gutangirira ni ho hantu ha mbere gusa. Niba Google Maps itashyizweho, inzira ifungukira muri porogaramu yo kureba urubuga, ishobora kwerekana ahantu hake; shyiraho porogaramu cyangwa uhitemo indi porogaramu y'inzira. Kuri Android, hitamo Google Maps cyangwa Waze. Niba porogaramu y'ikarita idafunguka, reba ko yashyizweho hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

entries.question: Ni iki gisangizwa iyo ntegura inzira?
