content.text: Kugira ngo hamenyekane urukurikirane, WitnessWork yohereza imyanya y'ikarita y'aho utangirira na buri hantu uhagarara kuri seriveri ya WitnessWork, ihereza iyo myanya gusa kuri HERE, serivisi y'amakarita, kugira ngo ibare urugendo. Amazina, aderesi, inyandiko, ingingo n'amakuru ya gusura ntibyoherezwa na rimwe. Ibyo bisabwa binatwara indangamuntu y'ibanga ya konti ya porogaramu, ifitanye isano no kugura kwawe kw'Umuterankunga, kugira ngo seriveri yemeze imimerere y'Umuterankunga kandi ibare inzira zawe; ntoherezwa kuri HERE. Seriveri ntibika imyanya. Ibika gusa ibihe by'ibisabwa by'inzira zawe byo mu masaha 24 ashize kugira ngo ikoreshe imbibi za buri munsi. Iyo ufunguye inzira, porogaramu yawe y'inzira yakira aderesi ya buri hantu uhagarara, cyangwa imyanya yaho ku kamenyetso washyizeho, nk'uko bigenda iyo ugiye ku muntu umwe. Isesengura ry'imikoreshereze ribika imibare nk'ahantu inzira yari ifite hangana iki, ntirihe aho uri na rimwe.

entries.question: Ese nshobora kwinjiza contacts muri book ya aderesi ya telefoni yanjye?

content.text: Si muri iki gihe. Contacts are entered manually in WitnessWork. This keeps your ministry contacts private and avoids accidentally pulling in personal contacts.

entries.question: Nshobora kwinjiza amakuru kuri MyTime, Ministry Assistant, cyangwa indi porogaramu?

content.text: Backup za MyTime zirashyigikiwe. Fungura Igenamiterere → MyTime Import, uhitemo backup y'umwimerere ya .mytimedb iva kuri MyTime, hanyuma usuzume incamake mbere yo kwinjiza. Imiterere ya backup z'izindi porogaramu ntishyigikirwa ubwayo. Niba ushobora kohereza inyandiko isomeka, Kwinjiza inyandiko bishobora gufasha kuyinjiza ukoresheje Scribe AI ku bikoresho bishyigikiwe iyo iboneka. Suzuma inyandiko n'imiburo bitangwa mbere yo kubika. Backup za WitnessWork za JSON zijya muri Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura.

entries.question: Ni gute nabika no kubika amakuru yanjye?

content.text: Fungura Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura → Kora Backup cyangwa Garura ukoresheje backup kugira ngo wohereze cyangwa ugarure backup ya JSON kuri iOS cyangwa Android. Ku gikoresho gishya, ushobora kandi guhitamo Kuri dosiye y'ububiko ku rupapuro rwo gutangira rwitwa “Ngaho nimukomeze mujye aho mwasize”; kugarura aho birangiza gutegura hamwe n'umwirondoro wawe wagaruwe. Backup zirimo inyandiko z'umurimo, gahunda, abantu, gusura, ibyiciro, umwirondoro n'amahitamo asangiwe. Kugarura bisimbuza amakuru yo kuri iki gikoresho arimo; backup za kera zishobora kutagira ibyiciro cyangwa umwirondoro, bikomeza uko biri. Indangamuntu y'igikoresho, igenamiterere ryo guhuza rya iCloud cyangwa Google Drive, uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru, uruhushya rw'isesengura n'intambwe zo gutangira bikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho. Amafoto ntashyirwa muri backup za JSON. Ku mafoto ya iCloud kuri iOS, fungura guhuza amafoto ukwako. Bika backup ya none mbere yo kugarura kandi uyibike ahantu hiherereye; ishobora kuba irimo amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu. Koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwihariye bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha ku bufasha mu kugarura.

entries.question: Backup yanjye isa nk'idasomeka cyangwa inyandiko nagaruye zirabura. Nkore iki?

content.text: Backup ya WitnessWork ni JSON itunganyije igenewe porogaramu gusoma, bityo ntisa na Raporo y'umurimo ishobora gucapwa. Komeza dosiye y'umwimerere uko iri kandi uyigarure ukoresheje Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura → Garura ukoresheje backup. Niba inyandiko zibuze, bika backup y'umwimerere, kandi ukore backup itandukanye y'amakuru y'ubu y'igikoresho mbere yo kugerageza kugarura nanone. Ohereza imeri ku bufasha ushyiremo verisiyo ya porogaramu n'ibyabaye; tegura mu ibanga uko dosiye zisangizwa. Dosiye za backup zishobora kuba zirimo amakuru y'abantu n'inyandiko, bityo uzirinde muri raporo z'ibibazo zishyirwa ahagaragara.

entries.question: Ibikoresho byanjye ntibiri guhuza. Nakwemeza iki?

content.text: Kuri iOS, koresha Apple Account imwe, fungura iCloud Drive, hanyuma wemerere WitnessWork muri iCloud kuri buri gikoresho. Kuri Android, reba “Google Drive Sync ntikora ku gikoresho cyanjye cya Android. Ni iki nakwemeza?” iCloud Sync ikenera uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga. Fungura Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync ukoreshe Huza ubu. Impinduka zitegereje koherezwa zongera kugeragezwa; dosiye idasomeka cyangwa verisiyo nshya ya porogaramu bigaragara mu mimerere, bityo vugurura ibikoresho byose hanyuma wongere ugerageze. Imimerere igaragaza Kohereza kuri iCloud kugeza Apple yemeje koherezwa, kandi Guhuza kwa nyuma kubara gusa ibyoherejwe byemejwe. Niba ububiko bwawe bwa iCloud bwuzuye, impinduka zikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho; vanaho ibintu cyangwa wongere ububiko muri Igenamiterere → [Izina ryawe] → iCloud maze koherezwa gukomeza ubwako. Bika backup yoherejwe n'igikoresho gifite amakuru yawe aheruka. Ongera wubake amakuru ya iCloud isimbuza amakuru ya iCloud n'amakuru y'iki gikoresho kandi ikuraho amafoto ya iCloud atarimo gukoreshwa. Ibindi bikoresho byawe bihindukirira ayo makuru ubutaha bizahuza, bigasimbura impinduka zakozwe kuri byo mbere yaho, kandi inzogera yo ku Ahabanza irabigaragaza. Banza uvugurure WitnessWork ku bikoresho byose: verisiyo ishaje ikomeza amakuru yayo kugeza ivuguruwe. Vugana n'ubufasha bwihariye uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha niba guhuza bikomeje kudashira. Ntushyire amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.

entries.question: Kuki amafoto y'abantu abura ku kindi gikoresho cyanjye?

content.text: Guhuza amafoto ni ikiranga cy'ubushake cy'Umuterankunga kuri iOS na Android. Fungura Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync (Google Drive Sync kuri Android) ufungure Shyiramo amafoto mu guhuza. Ibi byohereza amafoto y'umwirondoro n'ay'abantu mu bubiko bwawe bwite bwa iCloud (cyangwa mu bubiko buhishwe bwa WitnessWork muri Google Drive) kandi bigakurura amafoto yifashishwa; abarwa mu bubiko bwawe bwa iCloud cyangwa Google. Vugurura WitnessWork ku bikoresho byose kugira ngo ukoreshe ivugurura ry'amafoto neza. Guhagarika guhuza amafoto ku gikoresho kimwe bigumana dosiye zoherejwe na kopi zo ku gikoresho. Kugira ngo ukureho amafoto yoherejwe, hitamo Kuraho amafoto ya iCloud kandi banza uhagarike guhuza amafoto ku bindi bikoresho, bitabaye ibyo bishobora kongera kohereza kopi zabyo. Gukuraho umuntu cyangwa ifoto ye bikuraho kopi zakuruwe iyo iyo mpinduka ihagereye; kopi zishaje zo mu ikusanyirizo zisukurwa nyuma y'igihe cy'umunsi umwe cyo gutegereza. Niba ifoto ibuze, komeza igikoresho gifite iy'umwimerere, reba ububiko n'uburenganzira, hanyuma ukoreshe Huza ubu. Koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwihariye bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha niba bikomeje kunanirwa; ntushyiremo amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.

entries.question: Ni iki kiba ku byo nahisemo mu gutegura, abantu basibwe n'inyibutsa mu gihe cyo guhuza?

content.text: Gutangira bushya gutegura bigira ingaruka kuri iki gikoresho gusa. Guhitamo Tangira bushya bihagarika guhuza na iCloud kugeza ubyemereye mu Igenamiterere; hanyuma uhitemo Huza byose cyangwa Garura uvuye kuri iCloud bijyanye n'ibyo ushaka. Garura uvuye kuri iCloud isoma amafoto y'amakuru y'ibindi bikoresho kandi igasimbuza amakuru yo kuri iki gikoresho nyuma yo kwemeza. Mu gihe cyo gutegura, igikoresho gisanzwe gifite inyandiko kikubaza mbere yo kuzisimbuza, kandi Abaterankunga bashobora guhitamo Huza. Gumana amakuru y'iki gikoresho bituma ibindi bikoresho byawe bihindura bigakoresha amakuru y'iki gikoresho ubutaha bihuza, bigasimbuza impinduka byakozwe mbere. Kugarura amakuru ntibyohereza mu Buddies kwanga gahunda zitari mu bubiko. Amakuru y'abantu basibwe ashobora kugarurwa abikwa kugeza ku minsi 90, hanyuma agakurwaho hagasigara gusa ibigaragaza ko yasibwe. Inyibutsa zongera kubakwa kuri iki gikoresho nyuma yo guhuza no kugarura, zigumana igihe cyo kwibutswa cyahiswemo kuri buri gusubirayo na gahunda; hakenewe uruhushya rw'amamenyesha kandi hategurwa inyibutsa z'ahazaza gusa. Kugira ngo ugarure, gumana igikoresho gifite inyandiko za vuba kandi ubike ububiko mbere yo gusimbuza amakuru. Koresha ubufasha bwa bwite bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha niba ukeneye ubufasha.

entries.question: Nakuraho nte igikoresho cya kera kuri iCloud Sync?

content.text: Buri gikoresho gikoresha iCloud Sync kibika kopi yacyo y'amakuru yawe muri iCloud yawe, kandi iyo kopi iguma nubwo wareka gukoresha icyo gikoresho, harimo na nyuma yo kongera gushyiraho porogaramu cyangwa kugura telefoni nshya. Gikureho igihe utagikoresha, urugero icyo wagurishije, wasimbuje cyangwa wasubije uko cyari kimeze. Ku gikoresho kigihuza, fungura Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync → Ibikoresho maze ukande Kuraho iruhande rw'igikoresho cya kera. Ibikoresho bitahuje mu minsi 90 cyangwa irenga biragaragazwa. Gukuraho bisiba gusa kopi y'icyo gikoresho muri iCloud, harimo n'amakuru yacyo y'abantu basibwe ahandi. Iki gikoresho kigumana ibyo cyamaze guhuza, kandi ibindi bikoresho byawe ntibihinduka. Niba igikoresho cyakuweho kigikoreshwa, cyongera kohereza amakuru yacyo ubutaha gihuza; banza uzimye iCloud Sync kuri cyo niba ushaka ko gihagarara. Mbere yo gukuraho igikoresho, iki gikoresho kigomba kurangiza guhuza amakuru yacyo; nibisabwa, garuka, ukande Huza ubu, ukosore ikibazo cyose uko gihagaze kigaragaza. Niba igikoresho gikoresha verisiyo nshya ya WitnessWork, banza uvugurure iki. Ibikoresho byasimbuwe na Ongera wubake amakuru ya iCloud bishobora gukurwaho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Amafoto ntabikwa kuri buri gikoresho, bityo gukuraho igikoresho ntibikuraho amafoto; koresha Kuraho amafoto ya iCloud kuri ibyo. Ibikoresho ni igice cya iCloud Sync kuri iOS na Google Drive Sync kuri Android (Igenamiterere → Google Drive Sync → Ibikoresho), byombi ni ibiranga by'abaterankunga; kuri Android kopi ziri muri Google Drive yawe. Niba ukeneye ubufasha, koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwa bwite bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru y'abo usura mu bitekerezo rusange.

entries.question: MyTime Import ivuga ko dosiye atari database. Nakoresha iki?

content.text: MyTime Import ikenera backup y'umwimerere ya .mytimedb yakozwe na MyTime. PDF, inyandiko yoherejwe, backup ya JSON ya WitnessWork, cyangwa dosiye yahinduriwe izina ikitwa .mytimedb ntibizakora. Bika kopi yuzuye ya backup ya MyTime ku gikoresho cyawe uyihitemo ukoresheje Igenamiterere → MyTime Import. Komeza dosiye y'umwimerere uko iri. Niba backup nziza ikomeje kunanirwa, ohereza imeri ku bufasha mu ibanga ushyiremo ikosa na verisiyo ya porogaramu; ntushyire backup mu kibazo gishyirwa ahagaragara.

entries.question: Nohereza nte raporo yanjye kuri Hourglass cyangwa NW Publisher?

content.text: Fungura Raporo y'umurimo y'ukwezi, uhitemo Hourglass cyangwa NW Publisher mu rutonde rumanuka ruri hejuru ya Emeza, hanyuma ukande Emeza. Suzuma kandi wohereze raporo muri porogaramu wohereje. Gukoporora no Gusangiza na byo birahari. NW Publisher yemera gusa raporo y'ukwezi gushize. Hourglass yakira igihe cyo kubwiriza ukwacyo, Igihe cy'inyongera cyashyizwe mu bisobanuro bya raporo bisanzwe; niba usimbuye ibisobanuro, reba ko biracyavuga ibyo ukeneye. Vugurura WitnessWork niba uburyo bwo kohereza bubura.

entries.question: Nandika nte gusura vuba?

content.text: Kanda + uhitemo Andika gusura, hanyuma uhitemo umuntu. Kuri iPad, Andika gusura… kandi iri muri menu ya File y'umurongo wa menu. Nta gushakisha, urutonde rutangira na Hafi (abari muri metero 250 hafi yawe, uwa hafi akabanza), hanyuma Gusubirayo bigeze (iby'uyu munsi n'ibyatinze mu minsi 30 ishize), hanyuma Vuba aha (abasuwe mu byumweru 2 bishize), hanyuma Abantu bose A–Z. Andika kugira ngo ushakishe; niba umuntu atarimo, kanda Ongeraho nk'umuntu mushya kugira ngo umukore wandike gusura nyuma. Umaze guhitamo umuntu, kanda Twaganiriye kugira ngo wongereho inyandiko na gusubirayo ku ifishi yo gusura, cyangwa Ntari mu rugo kugira ngo wandike ako kanya, hamwe na Subiramo hasi kuri ecran amasegonda make. Mu buryo bwo kurinda amakuru, Ntari mu rugo ntitangwa kandi ifishi yo gusura irifungura ako kanya. Hafi ni ubushake: igaragara gusa niba wemeye aho uri, kandi ntubazwa keretse ukanze Fungura. Aho uri hakoreshwa ku gikoresho cyawe gusa mu gutondeka urutonde; ntihabikwa cyangwa ngo hoherezwe ahandi. Niba Hafi ibura, reba ko aho uri hemewe kuri WitnessWork mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe kandi ko umuntu afite aho ari ku ikarita. Kanda ufate umuntu kugira ngo ufungure umuntu aho kubikora.

entries.question: Mbona nte ikiganiro n'igikurikira cyacyo, cyangwa nkazana mugenzi wanjye?

content.text: Kanda ikiganiro mu Biganiro byahise by'umuntu, ikarita ya Ibikurikira ku muntu, cyangwa umuntu ku ikarita y'ibiganiro yo ku Ahabanza, maze gifunguke mu rupapuro rutuma utava aho uri. Gukanda urwibutso rwa gusubirayo na byo bifungura aho. Hejuru haragaragara uwo mwari kumwe: umukande kugira ngo ufungure umuntu, cyangwa ukoreshe Hamagara, Ubutumwa na Genda. Hasi, umurongo uva ku byabaye ("Wavuganye na…", igihe, icyitonderwa cyawe n'imyanya yacyo) ukagera kuri gusubirayo, ufite akamenyetso ka Uyu munsi hagati, kugira ngo urebe ako kanya niba gusubira gusura biri imbere cyangwa inyuma. Gusubirayo bigaragaza igihe uzasubirayo n'uko hasigaye igihe kingana iki, ingingo, abazajyana, n'urwibutso. Andika gusura kigaragara umunsi wacyo ugeze, naho Hindura igihe igihe kikiri gifunguye. Gusubirayo kwatinze guhinduka ibara rya amberi, kwakozwe kuhuza no gusura kwakwubahirije, naho kwarekewe gushobora gutegurwa nanone. Nta gusubirayo, urupapuro ruhuza n'ugusura gukurikira n'uwo muntu, cyangwa rugatanga Tegura gusura gukurikira nyuma y'ukwa vuba. Kanda ikaramu kugira ngo uhindure, cyangwa ••• kugira ngo uhindure igihe, ukoporore icyitonderwa cyangwa ingingo, ureke gusubirayo, cyangwa usibe ikiganiro; gusiba ntibishobora gusubirwamo. Niba ukoresha Buddies, bagenzi batumiwe n'ibisubizo byabo bigaragara imbere muri gusubirayo. Igihe kikiri imbere, + icagaguye itumira umuntu ako kanya kandi isangiza gusa itariki n'igihe byacyo, izina rya mbere rya nyir'inzu, aderesi n'ingingo. Kugira ngo ukureho umuntu, hindura ikiganiro. Ubutumire bwa gusubirayo ntibuboneka mu Buryo bwo kurinda amakuru. Gufungura ikiganiro nta cyo bihindura, kandi gutumira mugenzi gusa ni ko gusangiza. Niba hari ikintu kigaragara nabi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko.

entries.question: Nkoresha nte ikarita y'Ibiganiro by'uyu munsi ku Ahabanza?

content.text: Ikarita igaragaza gusubirayo watekereje ku munsi w'uyu munsi. Guhera saa kumi n'imwe z'umugoroba (5 PM) igaragaza Ibiganiro biri vuba aha, byongeraho iby'ejo; ibyo bishobora guhindurirwa igihe ariko ntibyandikwa kugeza umunsi wabyo. Nyuza urutoki ku ruhande kugira ngo uve ku muntu ujye ku wundi. Iyo wagiyeyo, kanda Twaganiriye kugira ngo wandike ikiganiro ku ifishi yo gusura, cyangwa ukande Ntari mu rugo kugira ngo wandike igerageza ako kanya. Subiramo igaragara munsi y'ikarita amasegonda make nyuma ya Ntari mu rugo. Buto ya kalendari ihindura igihe cya gusubirayo. Kanda umuntu kugira ngo ubone icyo kiganiro na gusubirayo kwacyo mu rupapuro. Koresha buto ya ••• cyangwa ukande ufate umuntu kugira ngo uhamagare, wohereze ubutumwa, ubone inzira, Fungura umuntu, na Reka gusubirayo. Gusubirayo bibarwa nk'ibyarangiye iyo wanditse gusura kwose kuri uwo muntu ku munsi wabyo cyangwa nyuma yawo. Umurongo uri hejuru wuzura uko ugenda, kandi ikarita igaragaza Byose byarangiye iyo byose birangiye. Kanda Byarangiye, cyangwa ukande ufate umutwe uhitemo Funga ubu, kugira ngo uhishe ikarita kugeza wongeyeho cyangwa uhinduye igihe cya gusubirayo. Gusubirayo kutarangiye nyuma y'amasaha 4 y'igihe cyako kijya muri gusubirayo byatinze mu rwego rw'amamenyesha. Ntari mu rugo ntiboneka iyo uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru bufunguye. Gusura bibikwa nk'ugusura kwose ku gikoresho. Kugira ngo ukureho ikarita burundu, kanda ufate umutwe wayo uhitemo Hisha iki gice, cyangwa uyifungure nanone muri Hindura Ahabanza. Niba hari ikintu kigaragara nabi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko.

entries.question: Nshobora kubika inyandiko z'gusura nta gutegura gusubirayo cyangwa urwibutso?

content.text: Yego. Iyo wongeraho cyangwa uhindura gusura, zimya Gusubirayo hanyuma ubike. Gusura n'inyandiko zako bikomeza, ariko uko gusura nta gusubirayo cyangwa urwibutso rwateganyijwe kandi ntikuzagaragara nk'icyatinze. Ushobora kongera gufungura Gusubirayo nyuma ugahitamo itariki n'igihe. Kugira ngo uhagarike urwibutso rwa gusubirayo rwa kera, hindura uko gusura uzimye Gusubirayo.

entries.question: Nshobora kubika andi makuru ku kiganiro, nk'igitabo nakoresheje?

content.text: Yego. Fungura Amahitamo → Imyanya y'ibiganiro, cyangwa ukande Ongeraho imyanya yihariye ku ifishi y'ikiganiro, wongereho umwanya nka Igitabo. Amazina y'imyanya ashobora kugira inyuguti zigera kuri 14. Buri mwanya ugaragara ku ifishi y'ibiganiro no gusura Ntari mu rugo; usige ubusa iyo bitareba. Agaciro kabitswe kagaragara kuri uko gusura mu mateka y'umuntu. Ushobora guhindura izina no gutondeka imyanya igihe icyo ari cyo cyose utabuze ibyo wanditse. Kubika umwanya mu bubiko biwuhisha ariko bikabika agaciro kawo. Uwusibe ku rutonde rw'Ibibitswe kugira ngo ukureho umwanya n'agaciro kawo mu biganiro byose burundu. Imyanya n'agaciro bikomeza ku gikoresho cyawe, bishyirwa muri backup, kandi bihuzwa hagati y'ibikoresho na iCloud Sync kuri iOS; vugurura WitnessWork kuri buri gikoresho kugira ngo ubibone aho. Ntibishyirwa mu byo usangiza iyo usangiza umuntu. Imyanya y'umuntu icungwa ukwayo mu Mahitamo → Imyanya y’amakuru y’abantu. Iyo uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru bufunguye, ntukandike idini, ubuzima, imimerere yo mu muryango, ururimi cyangwa ubwoko. Niba umwanya ubura ku ifishi, reba niba warabitswe mu bubiko. Ku bindi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko.

entries.question: Nshobora kubika umuyunguruzi w'abantu nkawuhindukiraho vuba?

content.text: Yego, hamwe n'uburyo bubitswe, ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga kuri iOS na Android. Muri Abantu, kanda buto y'umuyunguruzi iruhande rw'ishakisha (cyangwa ••• → Tondeka & Shungura…), hitamo imyunguruzi n'uburyo bwo gutondeka, hanyuma ukande Bika nk'uburyo hejuru, ubuhe izina (kugeza ku nyuguti 30), nka Ibyigisho bya Bibiliya cyangwa Ifasi y'Icyesipanyoli. Uburyo bwawe bugaragara nka buto munsi y'aho gushakisha, hejuru y'uturango tw'igihe cyo gusura bwa nyuma, no hejuru y'ikarita: kanda ubumwe kugira ngo ubugaragaze, hanyuma ububukande nanone kugira ngo usubire ku myunguruzi yawe bwite. Uburyo bukoreshwa ku rutonde no ku ikarita kimwe. Inyandiko zishakishwa ntizibikwa mu buryo. Mu gihe uburyo bugaragara, impinduka ukora muri Tondeka & Shungura cyangwa ukoresheje uturango tw'igihe cyo gusura bwa nyuma zishyirwaho Byahinduwe; kanda Vugurura uburyo kugira ngo uzibike, Bika nk'uburyo bushya kugira ngo ubike byombi, cyangwa Subizaho kugira ngo uzireke. Kugira ngo utondeke uburyo bwawe, kanda ubumwe, utegereze gato, hanyuma ububukurure ku murongo. Kanda ufate uburyo utimuye kugira ngo ubuhindure izina cyangwa ubusibe, cyangwa uhitemo ••• → Hindura uburyo bubitswe kugira ngo uhindure amazina, utondeke kandi usibe uburyo. Gusiba uburyo ntibihindura abantu bawe. Guhindura izina cyangwa kubika mu bubiko umwanya w'umuntu bituma uburyo bukomeza gukora; niba usibye umwanya burundu, imyunguruzi iwuriho irirengagizwa. Uburyo bubikwa ku gikoresho cyawe, bushyirwa muri backup, kandi buhuzwa na iCloud Sync kuri iOS na Google Drive Sync kuri Android; vugurura WitnessWork kuri buri gikoresho kugira ngo ubibone aho. Uburyo bugaragara bukomeza kuba kuri buri gikoresho. Kubaka imyunguruzi utayibitse bikomeza kuba ubuntu. Niba uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga burangiye, uburyo bwawe buhishwa muri Abantu kandi ntibugikoreshwa, ariko burabikwa kandi bugaruka uburenganzira bugarutse. Niba uburyo bugaragaza abantu utari witeze, fungura Tondeka & Shungura urebe imyunguruzi yabwo, cyangwa ukande Subizaho kugira ngo ukureho impinduka zitabitswe. Ku bindi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko.

entries.question: Gutondeka kwa Byatanzwe muri Abantu bikora iki?

content.text: Byatanzwe ni uburyo busanzwe bwo gutondeka urutonde rw'Abantu kuri iOS na Android. Iyo udashakisha, urutonde rutangira n'ibice bigufi bigera kuri bitatu: Hafi (abantu bari muri metero 250 hafi yawe, uwa hafi akabanza, hamwe n'umuhanda wabo), Gusubirayo bigeze (gusubirayo bigeze uyu munsi cyangwa byatinze mu minsi 30 ishize, ibyatinze cyane bikabanza), na Vuba aha (abasuwe mu byumweru 2 bishize). Buri gice kigaragaza abantu bagera kuri 5, kandi buri muntu agaragara rimwe gusa. Abandi bose bakurikira munsi ya Abandi bantu: abakunzwe babanza, hanyuma ibyigisho bya Bibiliya bikorwa, hanyuma ibyigisho byashize, hanyuma ukurikije gusura kwa vuba. Imyunguruzi yawe n'Uburyo bubitswe bikoreshwa mbere, bityo ibice birimo gusa abantu urutonde rwagaragaza. Ibice ubusa bihishwa, kandi niba bitatu byose ari ubusa urutonde ruba urutonde rumwe rworoshye. Gushakisha cyangwa guhitamo ubundi buryo bwo gutondeka na byo bigaragaza urutonde rumwe rworoshye. Hafi ni ubushake. Kigaragara gusa niba warimaze kwemera aho uri kuri WitnessWork; urutonde rw'Abantu ntirubisaba. Gikoresha akamenyetso ku ikarita ka buri muntu, kava kuri aderesi ye cyangwa akamenyetso washyizeho, bityo umuntu udafite aho aherereye ntashobora kuba Hafi. Aho uri hasomwa ku gikoresho cyawe iyo ufunguye Abantu, gusa kugira ngo hatondeke urutonde, kandi ntihabikwa cyangwa ngo hoherezwe ahandi. Kugira ngo imirongo itimuka mu gihe usoma, aho uri hashya hagaragara ubutaha ufunguye Abantu. Kugira ngo ukoreshe indi gahunda yo gutondeka, kanda buto y'umuyunguruzi iruhande rw'ishakisha (cyangwa ••• → Tondeka & Shungura…) uhitemo uburyo; Subizaho isubira kuri Byatanzwe. Niba Hafi ibura, reba ko aho uri hemewe kuri WitnessWork mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe kandi ko umuntu afite akamenyetso ku ikarita. Ku bindi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina na aderesi.

entries.question: Ibyibutso bya gusubirayo, gahunda n'abantu bikora bite?

content.text: Fungura Menyesha njyewe iyo wongeraho cyangwa uhindura Gusubirayo cyangwa Gahunda y'inshuro imwe, hanyuma uhitemo igihe mbere y'uko itangira urwibutso rugomba kugera. Kureka umuntu na byo bikwibutsa igihe yongeye kuboneka. Niba Menyesha njyewe izimye kuko amamenyesha atemewe, kuyifungura bigusaba uruhushya; niba warabyanze mbere, bifungura igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe. Niba igihe cy'urwibutso cyamaze gushira, ifishi irabivuga kandi nta rwibutso rwoherezwa. Guhindura igihe bigumana igihe cy'urwibutso wahisemo. Iyo urwibutso rugeze, runashyirwa ku nzogera yo ku Ahabanza, n'iyo amamenyesha ya sisitemu yazimye, kandi gukanda urwo ari rwo rwose bifungura gusubirayo, gahunda cyangwa umuntu. Buri gikoresho kiteganya ibyibutso byacyo gikoresheje inyandiko zawe zibitswe, bityo nyuma ya iCloud Sync cyangwa kugarura backup, fungura WitnessWork rimwe kuri icyo gikoresho kugira ngo ibyibutso bitegurwe. Gusiba gusura, gahunda cyangwa umuntu bikuraho ibyibutso byabyo, harimo ibyamaze kugaragara. Iyo uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru bufunguye, ibyibutso ntibigaragaza amazina n'ingingo. Kuri Android, sisitemu ishobora gutanga urwibutso rutinze iminota mike kugira ngo ibike bateri. Niba ibyibutso bitagera, reba ko amamenyesha yemerewe WitnessWork mu Mahitamo no mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe, kandi ko Focus cyangwa Do Not Disturb bitabihagaritse. Niba bikomeje kutagera, menyesha ikibazo uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha utashyizemo amazina cyangwa andi makuru bwite.

entries.question: Kuki hari umubare ku ishusho ya porogaramu ya WitnessWork?

content.text: Kuri iOS, umubare uri ku ishusho ya porogaramu ni ibintu bingahe biri mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza utarasoma. Amakuru aturuka kuri bagenzi bawe, nk'ikimenyetso gishya cya mugenzi wawe cyangwa igisubizo ku cyawe, ntabarwa na rimwe. Fungura inzogera uyimanure kugira ngo ushyire ibintu ku bisomwe; kubikuraho cyangwa kubisiba na byo bigabanya umubare. Uravugururwa WitnessWork ifunguye no iyo urwibutso rwa Gusubirayo, Gahunda cyangwa umuntu rugeze. Ibindi bintu, nka raporo y'ukwezi gushize cyangwa ubutumire bwa mugenzi, bibarwa ubutaha ufunguye WitnessWork, bityo umubare ushobora gutinda porogaramu ifunze. Buri gikoresho kigira umubare wacyo. Umubare ukenera uruhushya rw'amamenyesha; kugira ngo uwuhishe, zimya Badges kuri WitnessWork mu igenamiterere ry'amamenyesha ry'igikoresho cyawe. Iryo genamiterere rikora ku mubare gusa, si ku bimenyetso ukuza ku mwirondoro wawe. Kuri Android, ishusho ya porogaramu ntigaragaza umubare utarasomwa; launcher yawe ishobora kwerekana akadomo ku mamenyesha ari mu rwego rw'amamenyesha. Niba umubare ugaragara nabi, fungura WitnessWork, hanyuma uyivemo kugira ngo yivugurure. Niba ukomeje kudahura n'inzogera, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha.

entries.question: Nzimya nte amajwi y'ibyishimo n'ibyibutso?

content.text: Fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Amajwi n'Ibinyeganyega ukazimya Vuza amajwi. Ibi bigenzura amajwi y'ibyishimo n'ibyibutso WitnessWork ifunguye; ibyibutso biracyagaragara, ariko nta jwi (kuri Android, ni ubutumwa bugufi muri porogaramu). Ibyibutso bigeze porogaramu ifunze bikurikiza igenamiterere ry'amamenyesha ry'igikoresho cyawe; ugahindure ukwabyo nibiba ngombwa.

entries.question: Nzimya nte ibinyeganyega?

content.text: Fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Amajwi n'Ibinyeganyega ukazimya Ibinyeganyega. WitnessWork noneho ireka ibinyeganyega byayo byose, nko gukanda, gukurura ku ikarita y'ibishushanyo, n'ibyishimo byo kugera ku ntego. Igenamiterere rikoreshwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa kandi ntirihuzwa n'ibindi bikoresho byawe. Ibikoresho bimwe bya sisitemu, nka menu na switch, bishobora gukomeza kunyeganyega bitewe n'igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe ubwacyo; ugahindure mu igenamiterere ry'amajwi n'ibinyeganyega ry'igikoresho cyawe.

entries.question: Ni gute nabona amabwiriza yo kubonana n'umuntu runaka?

content.text: Fungura aderesi hanyuma ukande kuri aderesi yawe. Uzahabwa Apple Maps, Google Maps, cyangwa Waze bitewe n'ibyo washyizweho. Urashobora kandi guhitamo aho uherereye udafite aderesi, ibi bikaba ari ingirakamaro kuturere tudafite nimero z'imihanda.

entries.question: Igitambaro cyanjye kiri ahantu habi. Ese nshobora kuyihindura?

content.text: Yego. Fungura aderesi ya contact hanyuma ushyiremo pin ahantu hakwiye. Urashobora kandi gushiraho pin udafite aderesi na gato, ibi bifasha ahantu hatagira amakuru yihariye ya geolocation.

entries.question: Kuki ikarita itabona aho ndi ubu?

content.text: Reba ko serivisi z'aho uri zifunguye kandi WitnessWork ifite uruhushya rwo kumenya aho uri mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe. Ongera ufungure ikarita ugerageze nanone ahantu igikoresho cyawe gishobora kubona aho uri. Ushobora kandi kwinjiza aderesi cyangwa gushyira ku ntoki akamenyetso k'umuntu udakoresheje aho uri ubu. Niba ikibazo gikomeje, menyesha ikosa ushyiremo igikoresho cyawe na verisiyo ya sisitemu y'imikorere, udashyize amakuru bwite y'abantu mu mafoto ya ecran.

entries.question: Kuki abantu bamwe babura ku ikarita?

content.text: Ikarita igaragaza abantu bawe bakora bafite aderesi cyangwa akamenyetso, kandi ikoresha imyunguruzi imwe n'urutonde rw'Abantu. Uturango tw'igihe cyo gusura bwa nyuma, Uburyo bubitswe, n'imyunguruzi yo muri Tondeka & Shungura bikoreshwa kuri byombi, bityo umuntu uhishwe ku rutonde ahishwe no ku ikarita. Uturango two hejuru y'ikarita twerekana ibiriho; kanda Byose, kanda nanone Uburyo bubitswe bwahiswemo, cyangwa ufungure ••• → Tondeka & Shungura… hanyuma ukande Subizaho kugira ngo ubone bose. Niba uturango twihishe nyuma yo kwimura ikarita, kanda umutwe Abantu kugira ngo ubugarure. Ishakisha ry'ikarita ryonyine rigabanya gusa utumenyetso kandi ntirihindura urutonde. Umuntu ukora ushyiraho akamenyetso agumaho ku ikarita kugeza uhinduye ujya ku rutonde, n'iyo imyunguruzi yawe yamuhisha. Abantu warekeye ntibagaragara; ubashake munsi ya ••• → Abantu warekeye. Umuntu udafite aderesi cyangwa akamenyetso na we ntashobora kugaragara; fungura umuntu wongereho aderesi cyangwa ushyire akamenyetso ke. Bikora kimwe kuri iOS na Android, kandi imyunguruzi ibarwa ku gikoresho cyawe; nta kintu gisangizwa. Niba umuntu agikomeje kubura, reba aderesi ye, hanyuma uvugane n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha udashyizemo amazina na aderesi.

entries.question: Ese nshobora kongeramo ifoto y'umuntu ku giti cyanjye?

content.text: Yego. Fungura contact, kanda kuri avatar, hanyuma utore ifoto mu isomero ryawe cyangwa ufate indi nshya. Ibi bifasha cyane cyane mu gihe abakoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga basangiye amazina cyangwa iyo ifoto igufasha kumenya urugi rwiza.

entries.question: Ni gute nahisha contact ntayikuyeho?

content.text: Fungura umuntu hanyuma ukande "Reka." Uzahitamo igihe uzamureka (icyumweru 1, ukwezi 1, amezi 3, amezi 6, cyangwa umwaka 1). Umuntu avanwa ku nyandiko zawe zikora muri icyo gihe, hanyuma agasubira ubwabyo igihe kirangiye. Niba amamenyesha afunguye, uzabona kandi urwibutso igihe agarutse, bityo abantu warekeye ntibazibagirana bucece. Ushobora kubona cyangwa kugarura abantu warekeye igihe icyo ari cyo cyose ukoresheje ihuza riri hasi ku rutonde rw'Abantu bawe, ibikubiyemo bya ••• muri Abantu, cyangwa Igenamiterere → Abantu warekeye.

entries.question: Nabona nte abantu bagomba gusurwa?

content.text: Munsi y'aho gushakisha muri Abantu, kanda akarango kugira ngo werekane gusa abantu bo muri iryo tsinda: Bamaze igihe, Uku kwezi, Iki cyumweru, cyangwa Ntiwigeze ubasura. Buri karango kagaragaza umubare w'abantu bakora kabamo, kandi ibara ryako rihura n'iry'akamenyetso k'umuntu ku ikarita. Nyuza uturango ku ruhande kugira ngo ubirebe byose. Kanda akarango nanone, cyangwa ukande Byose, kugira ngo werekane bose. Uturango tumwe tuba hejuru y'ikarita, aho tubara gusa abantu bafite aho baherereye kandi tunyungurura utumenyetso; dukubama iyo wimura ikarita, bityo kanda umutwe Abantu kugira ngo udusubize. Kugira ngo uhindure uko dukurikirana, kanda akarango, utegereze gato, hanyuma ugakurure ku murongo; Byose guhora ari ako mbere. Gutondeka ni ihitamo, bityo kubikwa muri backup kandi bihuzwa na iCloud Sync kuri iOS. Amatsinda yubakwa ku gusura kwawe kwa nyuma, kandi "Ntari mu rugo" bibarwa nk'gusura. Kugira ngo uhindure igihe umuntu ava mu itsinda ajya mu rindi, cyangwa amabara, kanda buto y'amakuru iri ku mpera y'uturango (ku ikarita, buto y'ibisobanuro) hanyuma ikaramu. Akarango kongeraho umuyunguruzi ushobora no kubona no gukuraho muri Tondeka & Shungura, kandi gakoreshwa ku rutonde no ku ikarita kimwe. Abantu warekeye ntibabarwa. Nta kintu gisangizwa; amatsinda abarwa ku gikoresho cyawe.

entries.question: Ikarita, Buddies na Igenamiterere biri he?

content.text: Umurongo wo hasi ugaragaza Ahabanza, Ingengabihe, Abantu, na Iterambere, hamwe na Ongeraho iruhande rwabyo yo kwandika igihe, gukora Gahunda, cyangwa kongeraho umuntu. Iterambere na Ongeraho igihe bigaragara iyo inshingano yawe yandika amasaha. Ikarita iri muri Abantu: kanda buto y'ikarita iruhande rw'umutwe Abantu, maze WitnessWork ifungure uburyo wakoresheje bwa nyuma. Buddies, iyo iboneka kuri iOS, ifungurwa na buto ya Buddies iri hejuru ya Ingengabihe. Reba raporo iri hejuru ya Iterambere ifungura Raporo y'umurimo y'ukwezi urimo kureba. Kanda ifoto y'umwirondoro wawe iri hejuru ibumoso ku mpapuro zose z'ingenzi kugira ngo ubone Umwirondoro (inshingano yawe, igihe umaze mu murimo, n'imibare), Igenamiterere, Inkunga, n'Ikigo cy'ubufasha; ku miterere ya tablet ngari, Igenamiterere kandi rigumana mu murongo w'ibumoso. Niba warahishe umurongo w'ibumoso, kanda Erekana umurongo w'ibumoso mu mutwe w'urupapuro kugira ngo uwugarure. Niba warafunguye Hisha akamenyetso ko gutanga impano, Inkunga ivanwa muri iyo menu ikaguma mu Igenamiterere. Abantu, gahunda n'inyandiko byawe ntibihinduka; ahantu ubisanga ni ho hahindutse gusa. Niba hari ikintu kikiboneka ko cyabuze, vugurura porogaramu, hanyuma ukoreshe Uracyakeneye ubufasha? hepfo.

entries.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?

content.text: Koresha buto ziri hasi kugira ngo umenyeshe ikibazo cya porogaramu cyangwa usabe ikintu gishya. Andika intambwe zo kukigaragaza, ibyo wari witeze, igikoresho cyawe na verisiyo ya sisitemu y'imikorere, hamwe na verisiyo ya WitnessWork igaragara munsi ya Uracyakeneye ubufasha?. Kuraho amakuru bwite y'abantu, inyandiko, nomero za konti, Kode za Buddies cyangwa amahuza y'ubutumire muri raporo n'amafoto ya ecran bishyirwa ahagaragara. Ku bibazo bya backup cyangwa ibindi byihariye, koresha ihuza rya imeri ryihariye riri muri Uracyakeneye ubufasha? aho. Kode y'inkomoko, Politiki y'ubuzima bwite, n'Amabwiriza yo gukoresha biri muri Igenamiterere → Ibyerekeye.

entries.question: WitnessWork ishyigikira indimi ki, kandi nsobanura nte ubusobanuzi bwakozwe nabi?

content.text: WitnessWork iboneka mu ndimi 18. Ikurikiza ururimi rw'igikoresho cyawe mu buryo busanzwe; kugira ngo uhitemo urundi, fungura Igenamiterere uhindure Ururimi. Niba ururimi rwawe rudashyigikiwe, porogaramu yerekana Icyongereza. Ubusobanuro bukorwa hakoreshejwe AI, bityo ijambo cyangwa interuro bishobora rimwe na rimwe kuba bidahuye, cyane cyane amagambo Abahamya ba Yehova bakoresha mu buryo bwihariye. Kugira ngo umenyeshe imwe, koresha ihuza rya imeri riri muri Uracyakeneye ubufasha? ushyiremo ururimi rwawe, ecran, inyandiko ubona, n'icyo yagombye kuvuga. Ifoto ya ecran irafasha; banza upfuke amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko. Ibikosorwa bigera mu ivugurura rya porogaramu rikurikira. Nta mushinga w'abakorerabushake w'ubusobanuro wo kwifatanyamo ukiriho.

entries.question: Politiki y'ubuzima bwite, Amabwiriza yo gukoresha, n'impushya z'inkomoko ifunguye biri he?

content.text: Kanda ifoto y'umwirondoro wawe, hanyuma Igenamiterere, maze umanuke ugere ku Ibyerekeye. Rifite amahuza ya Politiki y'ubuzima bwite, Amabwiriza yo gukoresha, na kode y'inkomoko ya WitnessWork. Ku bikoresho aho Kwinjiza inyandiko biboneka, rifite kandi ihuza rya politiki ya OpenRouter ZDR igenga inyandiko wohereza kuri Scribe AI. Impushya z'inkomoko ifunguye zirondora buri paki y'inkomoko ifunguye WitnessWork yubakishijwe, hamwe na verisiyo yayo, uruhushya n'uwayikoze; kanda paki kugira ngo ufungure urupapuro rwayo, rugaragaza uruhushya rwuzuye n'inkomoko. Shakisha ukoresheje izina rya paki, uruhushya cyangwa uwayikoze. Kanda igihe kirekire ihuza iryo ari ryo ryose kugira ngo ukopore cyangwa risangize.

entries.question: Ibikoresho byo gukemurisha bikora iki?

content.text: Ibikoresho byo gukemurisha bifasha gukemura ibibazo hamwe n'ubufasha. Ubifungure muri Igenamiterere → Ibyisumbuye; bikoreshwa gusa ku gikoresho wabifunguyeho, kuri iOS na Android. Byongeraho urupapuro rw'Ibikoresho rufite ibikorwa byo gusuzuma, amakuru y'ikitegererezo no gukosora, bigaragaza amakuru ya tekiniki yiyongera kuri ecran zimwe, kandi bifungura kwandika amakuru arambuye yo gusuzuma. Ibikorwa bimwe by'Ibikoresho byongeraho amakuru y'ikitegererezo cyangwa bisiba amakuru burundu, bityo ubikoreshe gusa iyo ubufasha bubisabye, kandi banza ubike backup muri Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura. Gufungura cyangwa kuzimya akuma ntibihindura amakuru yawe; kazimye kugira ngo uhishe urupapuro rw'Ibikoresho n'amakuru yongeye.

entries.question: What does becoming a Supporter unlock?

content.text: Ifatabuguzi rikora ry'Umuterankunga rigufasha kubona ikimenyetso cy'Umuterankunga, amabara nyamukuru wihitiramo, uburyo bw'abantu bubitswe, na Tegura inzira y'uyu munsi, ishyira gusubirayo na gahunda by'umunsi mu murongo w'inzira ngufi, hamwe na iCloud Sync n'amashusho asimburwa ya porogaramu kuri iOS, na Google Drive Sync kuri Android. Abaterankunga kandi bahabwa umubare munini wemewe wa Scribe AI mu Kwinjiza inyandiko kuri iOS na Android aho iboneka; imibare yemewe y'ubuntu n'iy'Abaterankunga ubu igaragara mu Bufasha no ku rupapuro rw'inkunga. Ibiranga by'ingenzi bikomeza kuba ubuntu, harimo kuyungurura no gutondeka abantu, na Buddies iyo iboneka; Abaterankunga kandi bashobora guhitamo ibara rya buri mugenzi. Impano imwe (Tip) iguha izina ry'Uwatanze impano ariko ntifungura ibiranga by'Umuterankunga.

entries.question: Nishyuye, ariko ibiranga by'Umuterankunga cyangwa ibiciro birabura. Nkore iki?

content.text: Reba interineti yawe, kandi urebe ko iduka ry'igikoresho cyawe rikoresha konti wakoresheje ugura. Fungura Igenamiterere → Ba umuterankunga ukoreshe Garura ibyigeze kugurwa iyo igaragara. Impano imwe (Tip) ntifungura ibiranga by'Umuterankunga. Niba nta byo waguze bibonetse, ibiciro bidakururwa, cyangwa ifatabuguzi ryawe rikomeje kutamenyekana, ohereza imeri ku bufasha mu ibanga ushyiremo verisiyo ya porogaramu n'ibyabaye. Niba ubufasha bukeneye indangamuntu ya konti yawe, koresha buto y'ubufasha iri mu mutwe w'iyi ecran kugira ngo ufungure Uracyakeneye ubufasha?, hanyuma ukande Koporora indangamuntu ya konti. Sangiza iyo ndangamuntu mu ibanga. Kugarura ibyaguzwe bigarura uburenganzira, si inyandiko zawe z'umurimo.

entries.question: Umuterankunga wa mbere ni nde?

content.text: Abaterankunga ba mbere bari basanzwe bateye inkunga WitnessWork mbere y'uko urwego rw'Abaterankunga rutangira muri Gicurasi 2026, igihe inkunga yazanaga nta nyungu na nke. Izina ni ukubashimira gusa. Si urwego rwihariye: Abaterankunga ba mbere bafite ibiranga bimwe n'abandi Baterankunga bose, kandi ntirishobora kugurwa cyangwa kugerwaho ubu. Mu gihe inkunga yawe ikora, izina Umuterankunga wa mbere rigaragara ku mwirondoro wawe no mu Igenamiterere. Riturutse ku itariki watangiyeho kuba Umuterankunga, bityo nta kindi kibikwa cyangwa gisangizwa. Niba inkunga yawe irangiye, izina rihishwa kugeza utanze inkunga nanone. Rigaruka niba konti yawe y'iduka igaragaza itariki yawe y'ibanze, ibyo bikunze kuba iyo wiyandikishije nanone ukoresheje konti imwe. Niba witezeho kurigaragara, fungura Igenamiterere → Ba umuterankunga ukoreshe Garura ibyigeze kugurwa. Niba rikomeje kutagaragara, koresha buto y'ubufasha iri mu mutwe w'iyi ecran kugira ngo ufungure Uracyakeneye ubufasha? uvugane n'ubufasha mu ibanga.

entries.question: Ese WitnessWork iracyafite ubuntu?

content.text: Yego, kandi bizahora ari ko. Buri gikorwa cy'ingenzi gikomeza kuba ubuntu kuri bose, nk'igihe na raporo, intego, abantu n'abo usubira gusura, gahunda, Buddies, na porogaramu za Apple Watch na Wear OS. Umuterankunga ni ifatabuguzi ry'ubushake rifasha gutera inkunga iterambere. Nk'ishimwe, ryongeraho guhuza ibikoresho byawe, Tegura inzira y'uyu munsi, Scribe AI ikoreshwa kurushaho, n'ibintu byihariye nk'amabara yihariye.

entries.question: Bigenda bite mu gihe nahagaritse gushyigikirwa?

content.text: Kugira ngo uhagarike, fungura Igenamiterere → Gucunga ifatabuguzi uhitemo Gusesa cyangwa guhindura ifatabuguzi, cyangwa uhagarike mu mafatabuguzi yawe ya App Store cyangwa Google Play. Uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga bukomeza kugeza ku iherezo ry'igihe wishyuriye, kandi amakuru yawe asanzweho na backup zo ku gikoresho bikomeza kuboneka. Nyuma yaho, iCloud Sync irahagarara mu gihe uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga budahari. Niba guhuza byari bifunguye, bikomeza uburenganzira bugarutse; niba warahisemo kuzimya, bikomeza kuba bizimye. Guhuza amafoto bikurikiza igenamiterere ryako. Ibara ryawe nyamukuru n'ishusho ya porogaramu bisubira ku bisanzwe, ariko ibyo wahisemo bibikwa kugeza ukomeje gutera inkunga. Uburyo bw'abantu bubitswe buhishwa kandi ntibugikoreshwa, bityo Abantu hagaragaramo imyunguruzi yawe bwite; bugaruka uteye inkunga nanone. Reba Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync ku mimerere y'ubu. Niba ukeneye kuruhuka gusa, ushobora guhagarika by'agateganyo aho gusesa.

entries.question: Nshobora guhagarika inkunga yanjye by'agateganyo aho kuyisesa?

content.text: Yego. Fungura Igenamiterere → Gucunga ifatabuguzi. Kuri iPhone na iPad, hitamo guhagarika kwishyura amezi 1, 3, cyangwa 6. Guhagarika bitangira igihe cyawe cy'ubu kirangiye. Ntukatwa amafaranga muri icyo gihe, kandi ibiranga by'Umuterankunga bikomeza, harimo iCloud Sync, ibara ryawe nyamukuru n'ishusho ya porogaramu. Kwishyura bisubukura ubwabyo ku mubare umwe ku itariki yerekanwe, kandi ushobora gusesa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose mu mafatabuguzi yawe ya App Store. Ushobora guhagarika rimwe mu mezi 12; amatariki yo guhagarika abikwa hamwe n'igenamiterere ryawe kugira ngo ibindi bikoresho byawe bibyubahirize. Kuri Android, hitamo Hagarika muri Google Play kugira ngo uhagarike ifatabuguzi ry'ukwezi ku kwezi amezi 1 kugeza kuri 3. Ibiranga by'Umuterankunga nk'ikimenyetso n'ibara nyamukuru na byo birahagarara, hanyuma bigasubira ubwabyo igenamiterere ryawe rikabikwa, kandi ushobora gusubukura hakiri kare muri Google Play. Uburyo bwo guhagarika ntibugaragara mu gihe cy'igeragezwa ry'ubuntu, ikibazo cyo kwishyura, ifatabuguzi rya Family Sharing, cyangwa mu mezi 12 uhereye ku guhagarika kwawe kwa nyuma. Niba guhagarika binaniwe, nta cyahindutse; ongera ugerageze nyuma cyangwa ucunge ifatabuguzi ryawe mu iduka ryawe. Ku bindi, koresha Uracyakeneye ubufasha? kugira ngo uvugane n'ubufasha mu ibanga.

entries.question: Kuki wemera gutanga amafaranga?

content.text: Kubera ko ndi umuvandimwe wo mu Ngoro, mbona ari iby'agaciro gukoresha ubuhanga bwanjye mu gufasha abandi bo mu itorero. N'ubwo bimeze gutyo ariko, buri wese akoresha uburyo bwo kugenzura no kubungabunga ibidukikije, bitwara amafaranga menshi n'igihe. Njye mbona gutanga ari kimwe n'uburyo umuntu ashobora kwishyura gaz y'undi nyuma yo kujya mu murimo - ni igikorwa cy'urukundo gishimwa cyane.

entries.question: Impano zikoreshwa mu buhe buryo?

content.text: Your donation helps keep this app running! There are costs with buying real devices as development equipment, paying for location API service fees, build service API fees, app store fees, and opportunity cost of my many hours spent developing this app. Buri gice cy'ubufasha kirashimwa cyane!

entries.question: Where can I see what changed in the latest update?

content.text: Kanda ifoto y'umwirondoro wawe, hanyuma Igenamiterere → Ibishya, ubone incamake y'impinduka ziheruka. Ivugurura rinini rinafungura urugendo rugufi ubwa mbere ufunguye porogaramu nyuma yo kuvugurura. Niba uhisemo Nyuma, inzogera y'amamenyesha igumana inzira ya bugufi igana kuri rwo, kandi Ibishya bifite buto yo gusubiramo urwo rugendo.

entries.question: Ni iki kiri mu nzogera iri ku Ahabanza?

content.text: Inzogera iri hejuru ya Ahabanza ikusanya ibyibutso n'ivugurura, bityo bikaharira aho kwirundanya ku Ahabanza iyo ufunguye porogaramu. Uhasanga ibintu nka Raporo y'umurimo y'ukwezi gushize, kwimura igihe bitegereje, ibyibutso bya backup no kurinda amakuru, Gusubirayo byatinze, ibyibutso byamaze kugera, ibikorwa bya Buddies (aho Buddies iboneka), Kwinjiza inyandiko byiteguye, n'Ibishya. Akamenyetso gatukura kabara ibintu utaraba. Amakuru ava kuri bagenzi bawe, nk'ikimenyetso gishya cya mugenzi wawe cyangwa igisubizo ku cyawe, aba hasi munsi ya Ayo kuri bagenzi bawe kandi ntiyongera kuri uwo mubare; akadomo gato ku nzogera kerekana ko hari ayo ari mashya. Kanda ikintu kugira ngo ugire icyo gikoraho, kanda X kugira ngo ugikureho, cyangwa ukande Kuraho byose. Ubutumire n'ibisabwa bigitegereje igisubizo cyawe bigumaho kugeza usubije. Ikintu wakuyeho ntigaruka. Ibyo wabonye cyangwa wakuyeho bibukwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa.

entries.question: Nasangiza nte WitnessWork incuti yanjye?

content.text: Kanda ifoto y'umwirondoro wawe, hanyuma Igenamiterere → Sangiza WitnessWork. Hitamo Android cyangwa iPhone, maze incuti yawe ishobore gusikana kode ikoresheje kamera ya telefoni yayo kugira ngo ifungure WitnessWork muri Google Play cyangwa App Store. Sangiza ihuza yohereza ubutumwa burimo amahuza yombi y'amaduka, bityo bikora ku muntu wese. WitnessWork ni ubuntu kuri byombi. Ubutumwa burimo amahuza y'amaduka gusa — nta kintu kikuvuga cyangwa inyandiko zawe. Niba kode itasikanwa, ongera urumuri rwa ecran yawe cyangwa ukoreshe Sangiza ihuza.

entries.question: WitnessWork iri kuri Android?

content.text: Yego. WitnessWork yagarutse kuri Google Play, kandi ni ubuntu. Igihe na raporo, igihe kibarwa, abantu na gusubirayo, gahunda, ikarita (hamwe na Google Maps), ibirometero, ibyibutso, na backup byose bikora kuri Android. Buddies na yo ikora kuri Android, harimo na bagenzi bakoresha iPhone. Abaterankunga bashobora guhuza ibikoresho byabo bya Android bakoresheje Google Drive Sync. Ibiranga bimwe bishingiye kuri serivisi za Apple bigume kuri iPhone na iPad: iCloud Sync, widget, Live Activities, n'amashusho ya porogaramu. Kwinjiza inyandiko ukoresheje Scribe AI biri gutangwa buhoro buhoro kuri Android. Kugira ngo wimukire kuri telefoni nshya ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose, kora backup (Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura → Kora Backup), wimure dosiye kuri telefoni nshya, hanyuma uhitemo Kuri dosiye y'ububiko ku rupapuro rwo gutangira rwitwa “Ngaho nimukomeze mujye aho mwasize”. Hagati y'ibikoresho bya Android ushobora kandi guhitamo Kuri Google Drive aho. Bika dosiye za backup mu ibanga; zishobora kuba zirimo amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu.
